title: Rethinking Converter Synchronization: 2-Year Postdoctoral Position in Battery Energy Storage Systems
description:
Are you eager to contribute to a bold experimental research project at the forefront of power electronics and energy storage? We are offering an exciting 2-year postdoctoral position for a talented researcher to investigate advanced converter synchronization and control methods for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), with particular emphasis on exploiting naturally occurring acoustic and vibration information. The project combines converter control, sensing, signal processing, and experimental validation to explore new approaches toward simpler, more robust, and scalable BESS operation. This position is expected to start from 1st of January 2027, or as soon as possible hereafter.

About the projectThe position is affiliated with the VILLUM Experiment project A-choir and the EMI/EMC In Power Electronics research group at AAU Energy. The project investigates new synchronization concepts for multi-converter BESSs by combining power electronics, sensing, signal processing, and control. A particular focus is placed on whether physical signatures naturally generated during converter operation can provide useful information for synchronization and coordination. 

You will join a research environment working across power electronics, EMI/EMC, converter control, multi-physics analysis, and experimental validation with applications including battery energy storage systems and other converter-dominated energy systems, with opportunities for collaboration across disciplines. The position also offers opportunities for international scientific exchange, participation in leading conferences, and may include research visits to relevant academic or industrial partners.

Your work tasksYou will:

  • Develop and investigate synchronization and coordination methods for power electronic converters.
  • Develop sensing and signal-processing methods for acoustic and vibration measurements.
  • Establish and evaluate relationships between physical signatures and converter switching/operating behaviors.
  • Implement and validate the developed methods using real-time control platforms, HIL, and experimental converter setups.
  • Assess the proposed approaches under representative BESS operating conditions, including robustness to interference and multi-converter interactions.
  • Contribute to the coordination of related research activities, and disseminate results through scientific publications, conferences, and project deliverables.

The position may also include a limited amount of teaching and supervision in areas related to your expertise.

Your competenciesWe expect you to have:

  • A PhD in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Documented experience in power electronics, power converter modelling and control, converter synchronization, signal processing, EMI/EMC, or related areas.
  • Strong programming and experimental skills using DSP, MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS, hardware-in-the-loop implementation or comparable tools.
  • Experience with one or more relevant methods, such as synchronization and coordination control, digital signal processing, time-frequency analysis, data-driven modelling, or machine learning.
  • Good knowledge of battery storage systems or multi-converter systems; experience with synchronization control, hierarchical control, hardware design, or AI-assisted signal would be an advantage.
  • A strong scientific publication record appropriate to your career stage.
  • The ability to conduct independent research, collaborate across disciplines, and communicate effectively with academic and industrial partners.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

You are not expected to be an expert in all technical areas covering power electronics, acoustic/vibration sensing, signal processing, or machine learning. Strong competence in power converter control and synchronization, together with solid experimental skills and the ability to work across sensing, EMI/EMC, and system-level interactions, is particularly important. We value scientific independence, critical thinking, strong experimental skills, and a rigorous approach to modelling, implementation, validation, and documentation.

Who we areThe position will be based in the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems” at Department of Energy in Aalborg University (AAU Energy). AAU Energy is an international research department at Aalborg University dedicated to developing clean and sustainable energy systems across electrical, thermal, and mechatronic energy technologies. We offer an interdisciplinary research environment, advanced laboratory facilities, and extensive collaboration with industry and academic partners. The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg; this position is based at the Aalborg campus. Read more at www.energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Postdoc”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design
description:
At AAU Energy, a fixed-term position as Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design, is open for appointment from January 1, 2027, or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is 2 years.

Your work tasksYour work will include developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models based on circuit data, board geometries, simulation results and design images. You will develop surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic solvers, enabling faster evaluation of design alternatives. The position may also involve computer vision for recognizing circuit structures, component placements and printed circuit board geometries from photographs or other images. In addition, you will investigate graph-based methods for representing circuit relationships, evaluating design rules and generating or testing hypotheses for circuit designs. You will contribute to the development and verification of agentic workflows, where artificial intelligence systems combine models, tools and design rules to reason through and support electronics design tasks. You will prepare datasets, document computational workflows, validate model performance and share results with colleagues working in artificial intelligence, power electronics, semiconductors and software development.

The position is offered within the research field of Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design and contributes to AAU Energy’s focus areas of Digital Transformation and Artificial Intelligence, and Energy Efficiency in Components and Systems. The Research Assistant will be affiliated with the Section of Power Electronics System Integration and Materials.

Your competenciesYou have a relevant master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics, artificial intelligence or a related field, and you are interested in working at the intersection of machine learning and power electronics design. You have a solid foundation in applied machine learning. Familiarity with electronic systems, including printed circuit boards, circuit topologies, components and the physical principles that influence electrical, thermal and electromagnetic performance, will help you engage with the engineering context of the role.

You have practical experience developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models, and you can translate complex engineering challenges into data-driven methods suited to a research environment. You are comfortable working with structured and unstructured engineering data, including circuit representations, board geometries, simulation data and images. Experience with computer vision, graph-based machine learning or graph neural networks will support your work with methods that interpret circuit layouts and geometries, reason about relationships between components, and generate or assess design hypotheses.

You are interested in developing surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic simulation tools while maintaining sufficient accuracy for use in electronics-design workflows. You work systematically with model validation, data quality and reproducible experiments, and you understand that artificial intelligence methods for engineering need to be technically robust as well as useful to domain specialists.

You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and dialogue, and you work well in a multidisciplinary environment where colleagues with expertise in artificial intelligence, power electronics and software development collaborate closely. You take responsibility for your tasks, ask constructive questions when assumptions need clarification, and contribute with curiosity and sound technical judgement to the development of new methods for intelligent electronic-system design.

Who we areAAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. title: Senior Electrical Engineer, High Voltage (GIS); Location: DK - Esbjerg
description:
Are you a seasoned HV engineer with extensive GIS expertise? Do you understand what it takes to specify the right GIS solution and navigate the trade-offs between performance, reliability, cost, footprint and delivery schedules? Can you translate customer requirements into practical, value-driven solutions? Then join our team and help shape the projects that are driving the global transition towards renewable energy!Your position In your new position, you will be a key contributor to our major tender projects, collaborating closely with a team of experienced engineers to translate customer requirements into robust and scalable offerings. Drawing on your expertise in high-voltage GIS solutions, you will help shape technical decisions, collaborate with strategic suppliers, and strengthen our value proposition.Beyond tender activities, you will contribute to the continuous development of our HV competencies, product portfolio, and ways of working, helping strengthen our technical foundation for future growth.You will join our Product Line Management (PLM) Solution Engineering team, a multidisciplinary group collaborating with customers, suppliers and colleagues across the organization.As part of PLM, you will contribute to our ambition of making offshore substations more modular, standardized, and repeatable.You will help define not only the solutions we deliver today, but also the solutions we bring to market tomorrow.Building on our strong offshore substation capabilities, we are also exploring opportunities within onshore substations. Experience with onshore transmission systems, including EHV GIS/AIS, grid transformers, reactive compensation, harmonic filtering or grid connection equipment, will therefore be considered an advantage and may provide opportunities to contribute beyond our offshore portfolio.Working in an international and collaborative environment, you will help transform proven engineering concepts into repeatable products that support the continued growth of renewable energy worldwide.The position is full-time and includes approximately 10-30 travel days per year. We place a high value on flexibility, and most travel can be planned to align with both business requirements and personal preferences."We have built a leading position within offshore substations, and PLM plays a key role in ensuring that we maintain and strengthen that position. By developing scalable solutions, standardizing our products, and challenging established ways of working, we make sure that we are ready to meet the demands of both today’s and tomorrow’s energy markets. We currently support projects across Europe, the UK, North America, and Asia, but our ambition is simple: to be ready wherever the next opportunity emerges."– Jannick Elmbæk Olsen, Director, Product Line ManagementYour tasks & responsibilitiesAs our new Senior High Voltage Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, positioning, and continuous improvement of the products and solutions offered within our offshore substation product line. Working closely with customers, suppliers, procurement, and our project execution teams, you will help shape solutions that remain competitive, scalable, and aligned with future market demands.Your tasks will include:
  • Support tender activities by defining and evaluating 66 kV and 230/275 kV GIS solutions.
  • Translate customer needs, market trends, and supplier capabilities into competitive product offerings.
  • Optimize solutions with respect to performance, reliability, footprint, cost, and lead time.
  • Develop and maintain the GIS product roadmap in line with future market requirements and emerging technologies.
  • Collaborate with Procurement and strategic suppliers to strengthen competitiveness and drive cost optimization.
  • Contribute to the standardization and modularization of our GIS product portfolio.
  • Ensure a seamless handover of as-sold solutions to our EPC engineering teams.
Your profile & qualifications To succeed in this role, you are an experienced High Voltage Engineer with extensive GIS expertise and a passion for developing competitive solutions for the renewable energy industry.We imagine that you:
  • Hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Have extensive experience with medium- and high-voltage GIS systems, including 66 kV array systems and 230/275 kV transmission-level applications, from offshore wind, utilities, transmission, manufacturing, or EPC projects.
  • Experience with offshore GIS applications, technology qualification, or emerging SF6-free switchgear technologies is considered an advantage.
  • Understand the technical and commercial drivers behind GIS selection, including performance, cost, footprint, weight, and lead time.
  • Are comfortable working with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to balance technical and commercial requirements.
  • Have a strategic mindset and enjoy translating market needs into scalable product offerings.
  • Communicate clearly in English and can translate complex technical topics into sound business decisions.
  • Thrive in a collaborative and international environment and enjoy working across disciplines and cultures.
  • If you also bring experience or exposure to onshore substations, grid connections, or related high-voltage systems, we would be interested to hear about it.
Welcome to Semco Maritime At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   Care to join the movement? Change. With us. Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Lead Game Programmer
description:
Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.Here’s what that looks like day to day

  • In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

  • You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

  • You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

  • You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

  • You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

  • Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

This includes things like...

  • Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

  • Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

  • Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

  • Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

  • Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

You’re a great match if

  • You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

  • You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

  • You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

  • You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

  • You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

Nice to haves

  • You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

  • Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

  • Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

  • Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

  • Experience building systemic or open-world games

What always matters to us at Triband

  • You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

  • You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

  • You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

  • You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

  • You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

  • You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

Practicalities

  • We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

  • For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

  • We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

  • Our working language is English.

We offer

  • Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

  • A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

  • Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

  • A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

  • Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

  • Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

  • Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

  • Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

  • Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

  • Pension plan and private health insurance.

  • Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

title: Videnskabelig assistent til kvantitativ dataindsamling og statistisk analyse i uddannelsesvidenskab
description:
Ved Det humanistiske Fakultet, Syddansk Universitet i Odense er en fuldtidsstilling som videnskabelig assistent inden for uddannelsesvidenskab med særligt fokus på kvantitativ dataindsamling og statistisk analyse ledig til besættelse 1. januar 2027 og ét år frem.

Den videnskabelige assistent vil skulle arbejde på forskellige større og mindre forskningsprojekter, alle ledet af professor Ane Qvortrup. Fælles for projekterne er, at de undersøger danske og europæiske gymnasie- og erhvervsuddannelseselevers trivsel, selvforståelser og undervisningsoplevelser. Yderligere projekter kan komme til. 

De primære arbejdsopgaver vil bestå i kvantitativ dataindsamling og statistisk analysearbejde samt deltagelse i øvrige forskningsopgaver i relation til projekterne. Der søges en medarbejder, der har stærke kompetencer inden for kvantitative metoder, herunder i særdeleshed surveymetodik, og som har erfaring med uddannelsesvidenskabelig forskning. Ligeledes forventes gode kompetencer inden for mundtlig og skriftlig kommunikation.

title: Senior Sales Manager for Renewables Service, Location: DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, DK - Aarhus
description:
Do you have a passion for building strategic customer relationships and turning complex opportunities into long-term business success? Are you motivated by helping accelerate the energy transition through offshore wind solutions? If so, this could be your next career opportunity. At Semco Maritime, we are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager to strengthen our Renewables Service business. You will play a key role in developing strategic sales opportunities, supporting key customer relationships, and securing service contracts for offshore wind assets in selected international markets. Your position As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will have end-to-end commercial ownership of strategic sales opportunities within the Renewables Division. Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will lead the external commercial journey from early opportunity identification and qualification through tender management, contract negotiation, award, and handover to project execution. At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector. You will be accountable for building and converting a strong pipeline of strategic opportunities into profitable contracts while developing long-term relationships with selected key customers. You will shape winning commercial strategies based on customer needs, market dynamics, and Semco’s capabilities, and ensure that commercial priorities are aligned across relevant functions.You will contribute to defining our commercial focus for selected customers and market segments, helping ensure that we invest our efforts where Semco Maritime has the strongest position to win. Your success will be measured by your ability to build strategic customer relationships, develop high-quality pipeline and convert complex opportunities into sustainable and profitable business.Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, our office located in Copenhagen or our future office in Aarhus. The position is full-time, and you can expect to up to 30 travel days per year. Your tasks & responsibilities As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will take ownership of strategic sales opportunities throughout the entire commercial lifecycle.Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will develop winning strategies, build strong commercial relationships, and identify growth opportunities across existing and new accounts. You will play a central role in shaping account strategies, developing customer-focused value propositions, and ensuring that commercial solutions are aligned with both customer needs and operational capabilities.In addition, you will represent Semco Maritime in customer interactions and industry forums, contribute valuable market insights, and help strengthen our commercial processes and best practices across the organisation.Your tasks will include but are not limited to: 
  • Driving strategic sales opportunities from qualification through contract award and handover.
  • Developing and executing winning strategies for key tenders and commercial opportunities.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with strategic customers and supporting key account development.
  • Leading customer negotiations in collaboration with technical, operational, legal, procurement, and finance stakeholders.
  • Identifying and pursuing business growth opportunities, including cross-selling, upselling, and framework agreements.
  • Ensuring high-quality commercial proposals, risk assessments, and governance approvals.
  • Promoting a strong culture of safety, quality, compliance, and integrity in all commercial activities.
Your profile & qualifications We are looking for a commercially driven professional who thrives in a customer-focused environment and has a proven track record of managing complex sales opportunities - preferably from the wind industry. To succeed in this role, we imagine that you: 
  • Have significant experience with complex B2B sales, opportunity and tender management, contract negotiations, and the development of winning strategies for strategic sales opportunities.
  • Bring experience from offshore wind, renewable energy, maritime, technical service, or related industries.
  • Have a strong understanding of customer decision processes, competitive positioning, value creation, and commercial risk management.
  • Have experience with key account management, account planning, and building long-term customer relationships.
  • Are comfortable coordinating cross-functional sales and bid activities involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Possess strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills and work in a structured, proactive, and results-oriented manner.
  • Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing, and are willing to travel as part of the role. 
Welcome to Semco MaritimeAt Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  Care to join the movement?Change. With us.Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Executive Director, People & Organisation
description:
Would you like to shape the people, culture and organisational foundations of one of the world’s leading humanitarian organisations?  

This is an opportunity to bring your global leadership experience to a mission with profound human impact. As Executive Director for People & Organisation (P&O) at the Danish Refugee Council (DRC), you will inspire employees, empower leaders and turn strategy into meaningful change – ensuring that DRC has the people, capabilities, structures and safeguards required to deliver effective humanitarian responses wherever they are needed most.  

You will join DRC at an important time and have a real opportunity to influence its global direction and organisation. The global humanitarian system is going through fundamental change, and you will help shape and adapt organisational structure, operating models and staff capacity to the challenges and opportunities of the future. Your portfolio is global and spans organisation and culture, HR and leadership development, surge capacity, safety, legal affairs and Code of Conduct. As a member of the Executive Management Team, you will help shape strategy, and you will lead approximately 200 colleagues across P&O functions in headquarters and countries. About the job 

Reporting directly to the Secretary General, you will set the direction for DRC’s global People & Organisation strategy and ensure that it becomes an enabler for DRC’s ambitions. In close partnership with the Executive Management Team and senior leaders, you will create the conditions for talented people to grow and thrive – while strengthening an inclusive, and high-performing culture. 

This role calls for a leader who enjoys moving between strategic ambition and practical delivery. You will ensure that global policies, systems, data, employment conditions and governance provide relevant and timely support to operations. At the same time, you will carry executive accountability for safeguarding, ethical conduct, legal compliance, safety and DRC’s humanitarian surge capacity – areas fundamental to DRC’s mission. 

You will lead and develop an experienced senior team; Global HR, HR Denmark, HR Operations & Analytics, Surge Capacity, Safety, Code of Conduct, Legal, management support, and change, leadership and culture. Based at DRC’s headquarters in Copenhagen, you will work across a global organisation and build trusted relationships with colleagues and partners from many cultures and contexts. 

The impact you will make: 

  • Shape DRC’s strategy, culture and global P&O agenda.

We welcome all nationalities to apply for the role. If you do not have the existing right to work in Denmark, DRC will support with applying and paying for a work permit.

title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

title: Pattern Design Manager
description:
Are you passionate about pattern design and motivated by bringing out the best in others? Do you enjoy taking the lead, driving projects forward and finding better ways of working, without losing touch with the craft you love?

Whether you're an experienced manager or looking to take your first step into leadership, at SELECTED you'll have the opportunity to lead a team of pattern designers and fitting assistants across menswear and womenswear while staying hands-on with pattern development.

YOUR TEAMYou'll become part of SELECTED's creative environment, where pattern design plays an important role in bringing our collections to life.Working closely with colleagues in Design and Buying, you and your team will turn design ideas into well-constructed garments, finding the right balance between creative intentions, fit, quality and commercial considerations.With responsibilities spanning both menswear and womenswear, you'll work with different perspectives and priorities, helping create a shared approach and strong collaboration across the two areas.

YOUR ROLEYou'll take responsibility for the team's performance and development while continuing to work hands-on with pattern development within your own product category.Beyond the day-to-day leadership, you'll drive projects, bring structure to shared priorities and help develop the technical standards and processes behind our collections. Your experience will be important in guiding decisions, solving technical challenges and ensuring progress across menswear and womenswear.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and developing a team of pattern designers and fitting assistants, supporting their individual growth and performance.

  • Taking hands-on responsibility for pattern development within your own product category, including fittings and technical adjustments.

  • Driving projects and coordinating priorities across menswear and womenswear.

  • Developing pattern design processes and technical standards to improve fit, construction and consistency.

  • Working closely with Design and Buying to find solutions that meet both creative and commercial needs.

  • Exploring and implementing digital pattern-making and 3D development tools where they can improve our work.

YOUR BENEFITSAt SELECTED, you'll be part of an international fashion business with high ambitions and a genuine interest in doing things better. We work across disciplines, challenge each other's thinking and believe that good ideas can come from anywhere. It's an environment where you're encouraged to contribute your perspective and make your experience count.We also recognise that doing great work doesn't mean working the same way every day. You'll have flexibility in planning your work and the opportunity to work from home when your responsibilities allow it, balancing time with your colleagues and the freedom to organise your own day.

YOUR PROFILEYou know your craft and enjoy using your experience to make others better. You're comfortable taking responsibility, bringing structure to projects and making decisions, even when different perspectives and priorities need to be considered.For us, your ability and motivation to lead matter more than whether you've held a management title before. You might already have experience managing a team, or you might be an experienced specialist ready to take on your first formal leadership role. What matters is that you can provide clear direction, involve others and create an environment where people can develop and deliver strong results together.

We imagine that you bring:

  • Solid experience in pattern design and garment construction within the fashion industry, including a strong understanding of fit, silhouettes and technical garment development.

  • The ability to plan, coordinate and drive projects involving different stakeholders.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to navigate different perspectives and priorities.

  • A structured approach to your work and an interest in improving existing methods.

  • An interest in digital pattern-making and 3D garment development.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOUIf you have questions about the position, you are welcome to reach out to Manja Ann Jacobsen on + 45 52 15 37 30. Otherwise, please send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 26 November 2026.  We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to take down the ad, when we find the right candidate.

LOCATION: Brande, Denmark.

title: Lave Dansk Mad / Head Chef (Køkkenchef)
description:
Job Vacancy Announcement — Jobnet / EURES

Head Chef (Køkkenchef) — Full-Time (DISCO-08: 343400)

Employer: Sbs Mad ApS / Cafe' Nims ApS

CVR Number: 46 31 11 75

Workplace Location: Banegårdspladsen 10, 2750 Ballerup, Denmark

Employment Type: Full-time, permanent (37-40hours per week

Start Date: As soon as possible.

About the Position

Cafe' Nims is looking for an experienced and dedicated Head Chef (Køkkenchef) to lead and develop our kitchen team. In this role, you will take responsibility for the daily operation of the kitchen and for a kitchen and bar team of 7–10 employees, working together to deliver consistent, high-quality results.

This is a position with real influence: you will help shape how the kitchen runs, mentor your colleagues, and contribute to building a strong, professional, and enjoyable workplace.

Key Responsibilities

Day-to-day leadership and management of the kitchen and bar team (7–10 employees)

Planning and organizing staff schedules, including weekend shifts

Ensuring food quality, hygiene, and food safety standards are consistently met

Overseeing waste management, including food waste reduction and correct disposal procedures

Managing kitchen finances, including budgeting, cost control, and stock/inventory management

Supporting the development and training of kitchen staff

Collaborating with company management and other chefs in the chain through regular meetings and courses

Contributing to results-driven improvements in the kitchen's performance

Basic Requirements

Proven experience as a chef, sous chef, or kitchen leader

Good communication skills in English (spoken and written); Danish is an advantage

Solid understanding of budgeting, cost control, and stock/inventory management

Knowledge of Danish food hygiene and safety regulations (e.g., HACCP / Fødevarestyrelsen principles)

Ability to work flexible hours within a full-time schedule, including weekends and split shifts

Strong leadership, organizational, and team management skills

Working Conditions & Salary

Working hours: Full-time, 37-40 hours per week

Weekly days off: Guaranteed and respected — a core commitment of the employer

Shift structure: Two-part (split) shifts on weekends where applicable to avoid excessively long single shifts

Weekends off: A full weekend off can be expected approximately every 3rd weekend

Salary: Fixed guaranteed gross monthly salary according to qualifications (minimum DKK 37,500.00/month / DKK 450,000.00/year in full compliance with Danish standards), plus the possibility of an additional performance bonus scheme on top of the fixed base salary, and paid holiday in accordance with the Danish Holiday Act (Ferieloven)

Benefits: A wide range of employee benefits

What We Offer

A position with genuine influence and shared responsibility for results

A good, informal working environment — professional, but with room to have fun and support one another

Opportunities for personal development as a leader

Regular communication and development opportunities with other chefs across the chain (meetings, courses, and training)

Passionate and dedicated colleagues in a supportive team culture

Opportunities for professional and personal growth

The chance to be part of a company actively working toward sustainable gastronomy

Candidate Profile

Has proven experience as a chef or kitchen leader, ideally with staff and operational management experience

Wants to succeed as part of a team, not just run a kitchen

Values knowledge-sharing, mutual support, and collaborative problem-solving

Is professional, reliable, and committed to high standards, while enjoying a good working atmosphere

Communicates well in English and is comfortable interacting with a diverse team

Believes that the choices made in the kitchen today can contribute to a better tomorrow ("Every Meal Matters")

How to Apply

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and interviews are held continuously — early applications are encouraged.

Send your application and CV to: Info@cafenims.dk

Application deadline: November 18, 2026

title: Commercial Operations Manager med hovedansvar for salgsafdelingen
description:
Vil du være med til at udvikle Det Gamle Apotek?

Vi vækster og søger derfor en commercial operations manager til en nyoprettet stilling med hovedansvar for vores salgsafdeling. Du skal sikre en effektiv daglig drift, lede et team på 4-5 medarbejdere og styrke samarbejdet mellem kunder, salg, indkøb og resten af virksomheden. Der vil desuden være opgaver direkte fra direktionen på tværs af organisationen, såsom assistance til ansættelser, mødestyring og opfølgning for direktøren på verserende opgaver.

DIN ROLLE

Som commercial operations manager får du det overordnede ansvar for den daglige drift og udvikling af salgsadministrationen. Du kommer blandt andet til:

  • At lede, motivere og udvikle 4-5 medarbejdere

  • At sikre effektiv ordrebehandling og god kundeservice

  • At koordinere tilbud, ordrebekræftelser og fakturering

  • At sikre vareprøver, vareoprettelse og kundedata

  • At samarbejde tæt med indkøb, lager og produktudvikling

  • At have hands-on med egne Key Account-kunder

  • At optimere arbejdsgange, systemer og ordreflow

  • At sikre kvalitet, overblik og rettidig opfølgning

  • Deltagelse i messer i DK/DE/FR - maks. 15-20 årlige rejsedage

Du bliver en del af virksomhedens ledergruppe og får indflydelse på den fortsatte udvikling.

HVEM ER DU?

Du har erfaring med salgsadministration, kundeservice eller en lignende koordinerende funktion – gerne med personaleledelse. Du har købmandsforståelse, stærke IT-kompetencer og arbejder sikkert med Excel og ERPsystemer. Du er struktureret, serviceminded og resultatorienteret. Du trives med mange opgaver, har sans for detaljen og formår at skabe overblik, engagement og gode resultater sammen med dit team. Du kommunikerer godt på dansk og engelsk; tysk er en fordel.

Du er fleksibel, også mht. arbejdstider, da der arbejdes med sæsonvarer.

Du arbejder med AI og kan se muligheder for effektivisering.

Du har fingeren på pulsen samt god smag og kan på sigt få medindflydelse på virksomhedens kollektion.

VI TILBYDER

  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår med pension og privat sygesikring

  • Et godt socialt sammenhold hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i fællesskab

  • En arbejdsplads i udvikling med plads til nye idéer og initiativer

  • En stilling med indflydelse som en del af virksomhedens ledergruppe

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

ANSØG

Send en skriftlig ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til direktør Henning Tygesen på henning@dga-engros.dk.

Tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Mærk ansøgningen ”Commercial operations manager”.

Du bliver en del af en udviklingsorienteret og dynamisk virksomhed, hvor der er kort fra tanke til handling. Hverdagen byder på faglige udfordringer, gode kolleger og rig mulighed for at præge dine egne opgaver i en moderne økonomifunktion.

title: Søfragtspeditør
description:
Det Gamle Apotek A/S Tønder søger Søfragtspeditør/speditør - med erfaring indenfor import søfragt, national og international transport.

Er du skarp til import søfragt og logistik? Trives du med ansvar, en alsidig hverdag og spændende udfordringer? Så er det måske dig, vi søger! Hos Det Gamle Apotek A/S søger vi til en nyoprettet stilling en engageret og selvstændig søfragtspeditør, der får en central rolle i koordinering og optimering af vores import søfragt – primært fra Asien. Vi søger dig, der arbejder struktureret, har et godt overblik og trives med mange forskellige opgaver og internationale samarbejdspartnere.

DIN ROLLE:

Du får en alsidig hverdag med ansvar for blandt andet:

SØFRAGT OG IMPORT

  • Planlægning, booking og koordinering af import søfragt, primært fra Asien

  • Opfølgning på containere, transittider og leveringsplaner

  • Daglig kontakt med rederier, speditører og transportører

  • Forhandling af fragtrater og transportbetingelser

  • Løbende optimering af fragtomkostninger og transportløsninger

LANDEVEJSTRANSPORT

  • Planlægning, booking og koordinering af landevejstransporter, primært i DK og Europa

  • Opfølgning på afhentninger, leverancer og transittider

  • Kontakt og koordinering med transportører og øvrige samarbejdspartnere

  • Indhentning og vurdering af transportpriser samt løbende optimering af transportløsninger

  • Håndtering af eventuelle forsinkelser og øvrige udfordringer i forbindelse med transporterne

DIGITALE LØSNINGER OG AI

Vi arbejder løbende med at udvikle og effektivisere vores logistikprocesser og forventer fremover i højere grad at anvende AI-baserede løsninger inden for blandt andet booking, shipment overview og opfølgning.

Derfor er det en fordel, hvis du:

  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for AI og digitale værktøjer inden for transport og logistik

  • Kan bidrage til at udvikle og optimere digitale arbejdsgange omkring booking, tracking og shipment overview

  • Du behøver ikke være AI-specialist, men du skal have lyst til at arbejde med nye digitale løsninger og være med til at udvikle vores måde at arbejde på

HVEM ER DU?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med import søfragt, national og international spedition

  • Gerne har arbejdet med import fra Asien

  • Har god kommerciel forståelse – erfaring med indkøb er en fordel, men ikke et krav

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og løsningsorienteret

  • Kan bevare overblikket, også når der er travlt

  • Er ansvarsbevidst, fleksibel og har sans for detaljerne

VI TILBYDER

Du bliver en del af en dynamisk og succesfuld virksomhed med spændende produkter, internationale leverandører og en uformel omgangstone.

  • Et spændende og afvekslende job med stort ansvar

  • En central rolle inden for transport, søfragt og import

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med fladt hierarki, korte beslutningsveje og masser af humor

  • Gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling

  • Et tæt samarbejde med både kolleger og internationale samarbejdspartnere

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

TILTRÆDELSE SNAREST

Er du personen, vi leder efter, og ønsker du at tage del i Det Gamle Apotek A/S’ spændende udvikling, så send en ansøgning på e-mail hurtigst muligt til indkøbsdirektør Bente Tønder på bet@dga-engros.dk og direktør Henning A. Tygesen på henning@dga-engros.dk.

title: Ambitiøse og nærværende socialpædagoger søges til Fogedvænget
description:
Høj faglighed styrker børnenes livsværdi – vær med til at skabe tryghed, udvikling og meningsfulde hverdage for børn og unge med særlige behov.

Har du lysten og evnerne til at gøre en afgørende forskel for de børn i Danmark, der indimellem har det allersværest i livet? Vi udvider vores normering på afdelingen og søger flere uddannede socialpædagoger, der vil være med til at sikre de absolut bedste rammer for anbragte børn og unge på Fogedvænget.

 

Om os og kerneopgaven

Fogedvænget er en specialpædagogisk døgnafdeling med intern skole under Specialområde Børn og Unge (Region Midt - SBU), beliggende i Hedensted. Vores målgruppe er børn og unge, primært med gennemgribende udviklingsforstyrrelser, autistiske træk og mentalt lavt funktionsniveau. Flere har intet verbalt sprog, og de kan have udadreagerende adfærd, når de føler afmagt.

Vores kerneopgave er at tilbyde en højt specialiseret indsats, hvor forudsigelighed, lav-stimuli og alternativ kommunikation skaber rammen for barnets trivsel, udvikling og livsmestring. Vi arbejder konsekvent og professionelt ud fra Neuroaffektiv Udviklingspsykologi (NAU), Low Arousal og LA2-U for altid at se bag om adfærden og forstå barnets indefra-perspektiv.

 

Kan du se dig selv i rollen?

Børnene har et absolut behov for rolige voksne, der kan skabe struktur og genkendelighed. For at trives og lykkes hos os forventer vi, at du:

  • Er uddannet pædagog, og at du møder barnet med autenticitet, hjertet og fagligheden forrest
  • Hviler i dig selv og kan bevare roen – også når tingene spidser til, og barnet har brug for, at du trækker dig og skaber lav-stimuli
  • Arbejder praksisorienteret og ser en ære i både det pædagogiske relationsarbejde og i at varetage personlige pleje- og sundhedsfaglige opgaver
  • Har lyst til at arbejde systematisk med Tegn til Tale, piktogrammer og faste døgnstrukturer
  • Kan arbejde målrettet med dokumentation, delmål og risikovurderinger i vores journalsystem
  • Kan arbejde fast hver anden weekend

 

Vi klæder dig fagligt grundigt på

På Fogedvænget prioriterer vi din opstart højt. For at du kan lande godt i opgaverne, tilbyder vi:

  • Et struktureret introforløb, hvor du i dine første vagter går som ”følgevagt” uden for normeringen
  • Tilknytning af en fast mentor i op til 3 måneder, som sikrer din oplæring i vores arbejdsgange, pædagogiske didaktik og kultur
  • Fastlagte og prioriterede opfølgningssamtaler med ledelsen efter både 4 og 8 uger for at sikre din faglige udvikling og trivsel

title: Grankoglen søger en pædagogisk assistentelev til opstart på hovedforløbet d. 18. januar 2026 på SOSU Østjylland i Aarhus
description:
Vil du være pædagogisk assistent inden for det specialiserede socialområde og arbejde med trivsel, udvikling og livskvalitet for voksne med udviklingshandicap?  Så er en elevplads i Specialområde udviklingshandicap (SUA) måske det rigtige for dig.

Hos os er du ikke ’bare elev’ – du er en aktiv del af hverdagen og fællesskabet, hvor vi sammen bidrager til at understøtte borgeren i at udleve ønsker, håb og drømme med udgangspunkt i borgerens ressourcer. Som specialområde er det vores opgave at hjælpe borgere, som har komplekse støttebehov og behov for et specialiseret tilbud. Derfor vil du opleve en høj faglighed i opgaveløsningen og du bliver fagligt klædt på.

Hos os vil du opleve

  • Et spændende og meningsfuldt arbejde, hvor du gør en afgørende forskel for voksne med udviklingshandicap og hvor der er et stort læringspotentiale
  • Indsigt i det pædagogiske arbejde med trivsel, kommunikation, struktur og relationsopbygning
  • Grundig oplæring og tæt vejledning/sparring fra erfarne kolleger og vejleder
  • Fokus på et godt arbejdsmiljø og en høj grad af sikkerhed
  • Et trygt læringsmiljø med fokus på faglig refleksion samt personlig og faglig udvikling

 

Hvem er du?

Vi søger elever, der er nysgerrige på faget og motiverede for at lære både i praksis og på uddannelsen. Du behøver ikke kunne det hele på forhånd – det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at udvikle dig.

Det forventes, at du:

  • Har interesse for at arbejde med voksne med udviklingshandicap med komplekse støttebehov
  • Har lyst til samarbejde, dialog og relationelt arbejde
  • Kan tage ansvar for din egen læring og deltage aktivt i både oplæring og undervisning
  • Er åben, engageret og har respekt for forskellighed
  • Møder stabilt og tager ansvar for aftaler og opgaver

Om uddannelsen og de formelle krav

For at starte på hovedforløbet til pædagogisk assistent skal du:

  • Have bestået Grundforløb 2 til pædagogisk assistentuddannelsen
  • Have en uddannelsesplan, udarbejdet af den skole, hvor du har gennemført Grundforløb 2
  • Hvis du er over 25 år, er det vigtigt, at du får lavet en Realkompetencevurdering (RKV) inden ansøgning. Den skal nemlig sendes sammen med din ansøgning. Du kan få en RKV ved at kontakte SOSU Østjylland. Se mere her:  https://www.sosuoj.dk/vejledning/realkompetencevurdering/

Der findes forskellige adgangsveje afhængigt af alder og erhvervserfaring. Du kan læse mere på Uddannelsesguiden.dk eller SOSU Østjyllands hjemmeside. SOSU Østjylland står klar til at rådgive dig.

Oplæringssteder, ansættelse og skole

Specialområde Udviklingshandicap er Region Midtjyllands samlede tilbud til voksne med udviklingshandicap. Vi optaget af at levere og udvikle indsatser til voksne mennesker med komplekse problemstillinger, som med udgangspunkt i borgerens ressourcer, skaber udvikling til øget trivsel og selvstændighed.

Specialområde Udviklingshandicap har døgntilbud flere steder i Region Midt. Den overordnede målgruppe er den samme, men vores døgntilbud er specialiseret indenfor forskellige områder af den fælles målgruppe. 

Om Grankoglen 

Grankoglen er et af landets få specialiserede tilbud til mennesker med Prader-Willi Syndrom.Vores mission at skabe indsatser, som kan være trædesten i borgerens liv mod øget selvstændighed.

Som medarbejder på Grankoglen bliver du del af en helhedsorienteret praksis, hvor vi forener pædagogiske, sundheds- og sikkerhedsmæssige perspektiver med beboernes ønsker og behov som omdrejningspunkt. Vi støtter beboerne i alle dagligdags gøremål samt planlægger og deltager i aktiviteter.

Du kan læse mere om tilbuddene her: www.sua.rm.dk. 

Ansættelsen er på 37 timer med skiftende vagter og weekendvagter. Vi arbejder med fleksibel vagtplanlægning. Du skal være opmærksom på din transporttid til dit oplæringssted. 

Under uddannelsen veksler du mellem skoleophold og oplæring. Skoleperioderne foregår på SOSU Østjylland, Aarhus. Når du er i oplæring, får du en oplæringsvejleder, som er din faglige vejleder og kontaktperson gennem hele din oplæring.

 

Løn, ferie og ansættelsesvilkår

Du får løn under hele uddannelsens hovedforløb og løn under ferie efter gældende overenskomst. Elevuddannelsen er omfattet af overenskomsten for pædagogmedhjælpere og pædagogiske assistenter.

  • Elevløn: ca. 12.800 kr. pr. måned
  • Voksenelevløn (over 25 år): ca. 24.700 kr. pr. måned

Lønnen reguleres årligt efter gældende overenskomst. 

Der er tale om ansættelse i hovedforløbet. 

Der vil i forbindelse med ansættelsen blive indhentet straffeattest. 

Ansøgningsfrist: d.  26. november 2026

Samtaler: forventes afholdt d. 1. december 2026

Opstart: 18. januar 2027

Hvis du vil vide mere: tilbudsleder Helle Vang Appelby på 61350507 eller afdelingsleder Flemming Rasmussen på 30665460.

Hvis du vil vide mere om uddannelsen, kan du læse på Social-og Sundhedsskolens hjemmeside www.sosuoj.dk.

title: Junior Finance Controller
description:
Kick-start your finance career in a growing international technology company.

As our new Junior Finance Controller, you will gain hands-on experience with finance operations, SAP processes, and financial controls while working closely with experienced colleagues in an innovative and globally expanding organization.

Based at our headquarters in Kongens Lyngby, Denmark, you will join the Finance Operations team and report to the Head of Finance Operations. This role offers an excellent opportunity for an early-career finance professional to develop both technical finance expertise and business understanding in a high-tech international environment. The role supports our continued growth and integration within the Radiant Opto-Electronics Corporation group.

You will be part of an ambitious company where we win together. Team spirit and mutual success are key components in our everyday work culture.

Tasks and responsibilities

Support Finance OperationsSupport daily SAP Finance activities, including transaction processing, master data validation, and basic troubleshooting to ensure efficient finance operations.

Manage Invoice Processing

Help ensure incoming invoices are processed accurately and on time while maintaining high standards of financial control and compliance.

Maintain Process Documentation

Prepare, update, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and other finance process documentation in line with group standards and best practices.

Contribute to Continuous Improvement

Support the standardization and continuous improvement of finance processes and frameworks across the organization.

Support Month-End Closing

Assist with journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting documentation as part of the monthly financial closing process.

Participate in Ad Hoc Projects

Contribute to various finance and administrative projects and tasks as required by the team.

Skills, experiences and qualifications we are looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • 1-2 years of relevant experience within finance, accounting, or a similar function.
  • Understanding of fundamental accounting principles and financial processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to work.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proactive attitude and willingness to learn and develop professionally.
  • Experience working with SAP FI or another ERP system.
  • Exposure to process documentation and SOP development.
  • Experience from an international company or shared service environment.

Questions You are welcome to reach out to hiring manager: Michael Forster, Head of Finance Operations, mifo@nilt.com

Interested?

Please forward your CV and application letter incl. answers to the 2 questions below, no later than 23 November 2026. We look forward to hearing from you.

1. Key experience #1

ERP Systems

Please describe your experience with SAP or other ERP systems. What tasks have you performed, and what did you learn from the experience?

2. Key experience #2

Accounting and Financial Processes

Please provide an example of a finance or accounting task you have handled where attention to detail was particularly important. What was your role and what was the outcome?

About NIL Technology

NIL Technology (NILT), founded in 2006, is an optical solutions company designing, developing, and manufacturing optical elements and components using high-precision nanoscale features. NILT creates competitive advantages with flat optics (meta-optics) in optical applications for 3D sensing, consumer electronics, machine vision, autonomous vehicles, telecommunication, and AR. With its background in mastering and nanoimprint, the company produces masters and offers nano-foundry services. NILT is based in Denmark and has offices in Switzerland, Sweden, Finland, US, and a manufacturing in Malaysia. NILT is owned by Radiant Opto-Electronics Corporation (www.radiant.com.tw).

Visit us at www.nilt.com.).

title: Leder for Budget og Økonomisk Analyse
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for Team Budget og Økonomisk Analyse på Professionshøjskolen Absalon? Vi søger en leder, der kombinerer solid økonomifaglighed med stærke samarbejdsevner, og som kan sikre stabil drift, udvikle medarbejderne og styrke den økonomiske rådgivning på tværs af organisationen. Vi søger en leder til Team Budget og Økonomisk Analyse med solid erfaring i gennemførsel af budgetprocesser og opfølgning til både direktion og budgetsvarlige i en offentlig eller statsligt selvejende organisation. Samtidig skal du kunne bidrage til den fortsatte udvikling af økonomistyringen hos os og sætte retning, motivere og udvikle dit team. Fundamentet er en ny økonomimodel, der understøtter Absalons uddannelsescentre og fællesfunktioner, samt et stærkt tværfagligt samarbejde i afdelingen. Næste skridt er at digitalisere, ensrette og optimere rapportering og processer - internt og på tværs af Absalon. Din profil Du kan omsætte strategiske perspektiver til økonomisk rådgivning for direktion, bestyrelse og budgetansvarlige. Samtidig kan du gå i dybden med bevillingstekniske spørgsmål og give medarbejderne faglig sparring. Vi lægger vægt på følgende: Ledelseserfaring. Du har erfaring som personaleleder, teamkoordinator eller projektleder og skaber resultater ved at anerkende, udfordre og motivere medarbejderne. Du skaber overblik, træffer beslutninger og kan lede forandringer med fokus på fælles metoder og løbende procesforbedringer. Samarbejde og gennemslagskraft. Du er en synlig og konstruktiv samarbejdspartner i økonomiafdelingen, fællesfunktionerne og Absalons centre. Du kommunikerer klart, driver tværgående processer og opbygger netværk både i og uden for Absalon. Ledelse på tværs af teams. Du tager ansvar for faglige områder med medarbejdere fra begge teams i økonomiafdelingen og bidrager til, at økonomiafdelingen fungerer som én samlet afdeling. Sammen med lederteamet sikrer du tydelige mål, prioriteringer og fremdrift. Forretningsforståelse og formidling. Med solide analytiske evner og strategisk sans hjælper du Absalons chefer og direktion med at varetage budgetansvaret og træffe velunderbyggede beslutninger. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra en selvejende uddannelsesinstitution og de logikker, der ligger til grund for økonomien. Derudover forventer vi, at du har en solid erfaring i budget- og planlægningsprocesser, økonomimodeller, ledelsesinformation, registreringsramme og økonomisystemer. Du har fokus på compliance og kan styre både resultatopgørelse og balance. Dine arbejdsopgaver Som leder af Team Budget og Økonomisk Analyse får du sammen med teamet ansvar for følgende: Digitalisering og effektive processer. Du ensretter processer, metoder, værktøjer og datagrundlag i økonomiafdelingen og på tværs af Absalon. Du sikrer, at teamet leverer værdiskabende analyser, budgetter og budgetopfølgning af høj kvalitet samt korte og præcise sagsfremstillinger til direktion og bestyrelse. Sikker drift og ledelsessparring. Du står i spidsen for tværgående økonomi- og virksomhedsstyring med fokus på grunduddannelse, efter- og videreuddannelse samt forskning og udvikling. Teamet udarbejder budgetter og forecasts i samarbejde med resten af økonomiafdelingen og har en væsentlig rolle i styringen af Absalons bygningsøkonomi og likviditet. Du og teamet rådgiver direktion og chefer, og du har ansvar for - og bidrager selv til - beslutningsoplæg af høj kvalitet. Udvikling af økonomifunktionen. Du bidrager til at styrke økonomifunktionen som strategisk økonomipartner med forretningsnær, analytisk økonomistyring og fokus på compliance. Du sikrer fremdrift i udviklingsprojekter og realisering af gevinster i driften. Du har det overordnede ansvar for effektiv økonomistyring på tværs af Absalon og for, at de økonomiske processer understøtter de strategiske mål. Daglig personale- og driftsledelse. Du bliver nærmeste leder for ni medarbejdere: controllere, økonomipartnere og en projektleder. Du prioriterer og koordinerer opgaverne og sikrer, at de løses i overensstemmelse med interne og eksterne beslutninger, regler, rammer og værdier. Du understøtter faglig udvikling og høj trivsel i teamet. Kendskab til vores økonomisystemer er en fordel. Vi benytter Navision Stat, Statens Budgetsystem (SBS), LDV og Power BI. Du får en aktiv rolle i udviklingen af vores økonomistyringsarkitektur i tæt samarbejde med resten af afdelingen. Dine kolleger Du bliver en del af Økonomi med ca. 28 medarbejdere fordelt på Team Budget og Økonomisk Analyse og Team Regnskab og Projektøkonomi. Lederteamet består af de to ledere og økonomichefen. Vi har et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med fagligt dygtige og engagerede kolleger, hvor faglig sparring og omsorg for hinanden er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Din arbejdsplads er Campus Slagelse, lige ved stationen. Herfra understøtter vi Absalons syv lokationer i Region Sjælland. Vi tilbyder en sund og varieret kantineordning og adgang til træningsfaciliteter. Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • En forventet løn vil ligge mellem 54.640 kr. og 58.039 kr. pr. måned ekskl. pension. Hertil kommer et pensionsbidrag på mellem 16% og 18,07% afhængig af din uddannelsesbaggrund. Der er mulighed for at forhandle et kvalifikationstillæg på baggrund af kvalifikationer og erfaring.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid, og vi vil gerne have, at du begynder den 1. januar 2027.
  • Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte økonomichef Vibeke Overgaard Larsen på tlf. 7248 2123.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 20. november 2026. https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger
  • Samtaler afholdes løbende.
Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen. Om Absalon Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for. I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder. Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund. Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

title: High School Psychologist / Social-Emotional Counsellor
description:
Role Overview

The High School Psychologist / Social-Emotional Counsellor is a member of the Student Support Team and shares responsibility for student wellbeing, inclusion and mental health across the High School. The role provides direct counselling, psychological support, consultation, and system-level guidance to students, families and staff, with particular attention to students who are socially, emotionally or psychologically vulnerable. Working hours and days are flexible and can be arranged to fit your existing schedule. You have the freedom to allocate your working hours across the week in a way that suits your availability while meeting the needs of students and the school.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide individual social-emotional counselling to students aged 15–19, supporting their mental health, resilience, relationships and academic wellbeing.

  • Design and implement preventive and systemic interventions at class and year-group levels to promote student wellbeing and positive group dynamics.

  • Develop, implement and review individual student support plans in alignment with the IB Access and Inclusion Policy.

  • Collaborate with the student wellbeing team, student support staff, teachers and parents to coordinate appropriate support.

  • Guide students and families through the Danish public and private healthcare and youth support systems, including PPR, specialist clinics and pathways to diagnostic assessment.

  • Prepare professional referrals and supporting documentation for external assessments, including neuropsychological or psychiatric evaluations, within the scope of professional competence.

  • Follow safeguarding, confidentiality and data protection requirements; identify students requiring specialist intervention and coordinate appropriate follow-up and support.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Relevant qualifications and training in psychology, counselling or social-emotional support. A qualification as a psychologist, including assessment and diagnosis, is preferred; demonstrated expertise in social-emotional counselling will also be considered.

  • Knowledge of the Danish healthcare and youth support systems, including PPR.

  • Experience with psychological screening and assessment tools such as WISC, WAIS, BASC, and BRIEF is an advantage.

  • Experience working within the International Baccalaureate (IB) system is desirable but not required.

Position Details

  • Reports to: High School Principal / Programme Principal

  • Works closely with: the Learning Support Team, Student Wellbeing Team, teaching staff, parents and external specialists

  • Position: Part-time (50%)

  • Start date: January 2027, or by agreement

  • Closing date for applications: 20 November 2026

title: Vil du være med til at skabe en tryg og udviklende hverdag for vores yngste børn?
description:
