title: Data Delivery Lead - Building and Technical Trade, K Group
description: Building and Technical Trade (BTT) is building its future data ecosystem on Snowflake. As our Data Delivery Lead, your job is to make sure data initiatives move from business need to production, become part of everyday ways of working and continue delivering value after go-live.Rather than carrying out the technical implementation yourself, your strength lies in connecting the dots: understanding what the business needs, setting direction for delivery and bringing business stakeholders, data and analytics experts and delivery partners together around a common goal. You will join the BTT Data, AI and ESG team in K IT and collaborate closely with colleagues in the team, business and IT stakeholders and external delivery partners. Together you'll turn business needs into reliable data solutions that support both daily decision-making and future growth.We work in a hybrid model, with at least one office day per week at our modern K-Kampus headquarters in Kalasatama, Helsinki. Depending on delivery needs, the role may require more on-site collaboration. Come and join our professional team and start building your own kind of career in K Group!What is the role about?You'll lead the delivery of business-critical data and analytics solutions in BTT and own selected solutions after go-live. Your work has three closely connected areas: - Data Delivery Lead (primary focus): You'll lead data projects such as data warehouse and BI renewals, platform migrations and new data product development from business need to adoption. You'll own scope, schedule, resourcing, budget, risks and stakeholder communication, keeping solutions aligned with evolving business and analytics needs. You'll coordinate data and analytics engineers, offshore teams and other delivery partners, while engineering teams own technical implementation and data modelling. - IT Business Partner for BTT marketing: You'll be the primary IT contact for BTT marketing. You'll turn business needs into technical requirements and collaborate with architects, development teams and service partners to implement solutions. - IT Application Owner: You'll be the IT owner of selected Snowflake data kiosks. This covers both business functionality and technical lifecycle, and you'll make sure they stay stable and keep developing.Together, these responsibilities give you the opportunity to influence both what gets built and how data solutions create value once they are in use. The role combines hands-on problem solving, project delivery, application ownership, service management, and participation in development initiatives both as a subject matter expert and as a project manager.Who are we looking for?We are looking for an experienced data professional who enjoys getting things done with others. You understand technology well enough to lead data and analytics deliveries credibly and know how to align business needs, stakeholders and delivery teams around a common goal. We expect you to bring: - proven experience leading data or analytics projects as a delivery lead or project manager - practical experience with Snowflake and a solid understanding of modern data platforms and data modelling principles - experience working across business, IT and delivery partners, including multi-vendor or offshore environments - an understanding of application or service ownership and the lifecycle of data solutions - excellent communication skills in English, including the ability to make technical topics understandable and challenge requirements constructivelyWe see it as an advantage if you also have experience with: - marketing technologies and processes - Qlik Sense or comparable analytics tools - using AI-enabled tools and practices in data solution delivery and maintenance - B2B wholesale or retail - Finnish or another Nordic languageA relevant academic background supports you in the role.Please note that the role is based in Finland, and you must already have the right to work here. Unfortunately, Kesko is unable to sponsor work permits or visas. Why join us?This role gives you something quite tangible to own: you will lead business-critical data initiatives all the way from need to adoption and continue influencing selected solutions after they go live. You will be working in a key role, building a modern data platform in a large and diverse organization. You will benefit from: - a genuinely impactful role where you lead business-critical data projects and see them through to real business use - you will work at the intersection of BTT business and K IT, collaborating with data professionals, business stakeholders, and delivery partners. At the same time, you will have the opportunity to deepen your expertise in modern data platforms and develop your career in a large international organization. - extensive K Group employee benefits, including a mobile phone benefit; the Epassi Flex culture, well-being and sports benefit; personell discounts in K Group stores; our own occupational health care services; leisure-time accident insurance; and a car benefit according to our company policy - partner benefits related to optical stores, accommodation and travel, as well as sports and well-being servicesK-Kampus makes office days easy and enjoyable, with a personnel gym, restaurant and café, convenient transport connections and free parking available.Interested? title: Ohjaaja (ammatillinen tukihenkilö, perhetyöntekijä)
description: **Haemme ammatillisia tukihenkilöitä ja perhetyöntekijöitä tekemään merkityksellistä työtä lasten, nuorten ja perheiden tueksi Keski-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueelle**Haluatko tehdä merkityksellistä työtä lasten, nuorten ja perheiden parissa ja samalla kuulua rennon, aidosti välittävän työyhteisön joukkoon? Me Tukiluotsilla etsimme kasvavaan joukkoomme tuntityöntekijöitä ammatillisen tukihenkilötoiminnan ja tehostetun perhetyön tehtäviin Keski-Uudenmaan alueelle. (Hyvinkää-Tuusula-Järvenpää-Nurmijärvi)**Keitä me olemme?**Tukiluotsi on vuonna 2024 perustettu kotimainen sosiaalialan yritys, joka tarjoaa yksilöllisiä ja vaikuttavia lastensuojelun avopalveluita. Toimimme lähellä asiakkaita ja yhteistyössä perheiden, verkostojen ja tilaajien kanssa. Meille on tärkeää tehdä työtä kohdaten asiakkamme inhimillisesti, ammattitaitoisesti ja asiakaslähtöisesti. Toimitilamme sijaitsee Nurmijärvellä.**Mitä työ pitää sisällään?****Ammatillinen tukihenkilötyö**Ammatillisen tukihenkilön työssä kuljet 12–17-vuotiaan nuoren rinnalla hänen arjessaan ja autat häntä löytämään omia vahvuuksiaan ja suuntaa tulevaisuuteen. Työ on tavoitteellista ja suunnitelmallista, mutta samalla joustavaa ja nuoren yksilöllisistä tarpeista lähtevää, ja siihen voi sisältyä esimerkiksi harrastuksiin osallistumista, koulunkäynnin tukemista ja yhdessä tekemistä. Tukihenkilönä olet tärkeä turvallinen aikuinen, joka kuuntelee, keskustelee ja tarjoaa nuorelle myönteisiä kokemuksia arjen keskellä.**Tehostettu perhetyö**Tehostetussa perhetyössä työskentelet tiiviisti koko perheen kanssa heidän arjessaan ja tuet heitä löytämään uusia voimavaroja ja ratkaisuja. Työ on tavoitteellista ja muutokseen tähtäävää, mutta samalla inhimillistä ja perheen yksilöllisestä tilanteesta lähtevää. Käytännössä se voi tarkoittaa vanhemmuuden tukemista, arjen hallinnan vahvistamista ja perheen sisäisen vuorovaikutuksen kehittämistä. Olet rinnalla kulkeva ammattilainen, joka tarjoaa perheelle apua sekä pienissä arjen asioissa että haastavissa muutosvaiheissa. Työskentelyssä painottuu läheinen yhteistyö perheen verkostojen, kuten koulun, varhaiskasvatuksen ja muiden toimijoiden kanssa. Tärkeintä on, että perhe ei jää yksin vaan saa rinnalleen välittävän ja luotettavan ammattilaisen.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**- Vähintään 2 vuoden työkokemusta lastensuojelutyöstä - Mahdollisuutta työskentelyyn iltapäivisin / iltapainoitteisesti - Mahdollisuus työskennellä vähintään 25 tuntia viikossa (tuntimäärää voi myös kasvattaa halutessaan) - Sosiaali- tai terveysalan korkeakoulututkintoa (esim. sosionomi AMK, sairaanhoitaja) - Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta (kilometrikorvaus 0,55 €/km) - Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa (suullinen ja kirjallinen) - Rikosrekisteriotteen esittäminen (lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelyä varten) - Rekisteröintiä Valviran JulkiTerhikki/JulkiSuosikki-rekisteriin **Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**- Palkkaus yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukaisesti, palkkaluokka G24d (+ ilta- ja viikonloppulisät sekä lomakorvaus) - Kilometrikorvaukset työajoista - Ennaltaehkäisevän työterveyden ja etälääkäripalvelut - Perehdytyksen ja esihenkilön tuen, et jää yksin haastavissakaan tilanteissa - Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omiin työaikoihisi ja työn sisältöön - Rennon ja välittömän työyhteisön, jossa huumori ja aitous kuuluvat arkeen **Kiinnostuitko?**Jos haluat olla mukana rakentamassa merkityksellistä ja vaikuttavaa työtä lasten ja perheiden parhaaksi, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme! You will play a key role in helping customers solve technical challenges, identify the right solutions for their applications and deliver outstanding engineering support throughout the customer lifecycle.This position offers the opportunity to work with a broad range of customers and technologies while contributing to product selection, troubleshooting, technical proposal development and engineering projects across the region.The successful candidate will be a technically capable and commercially minded engineer who enjoys collaborating with customers and cross-functional teams to deliver practical solutions and exceptional service.Duties & Responsibilities (not limited to)- Provide technical support, application engineering expertise and technical proposals across Wet Seals, Wet Seal Systems, Couplings and Filtration products. - Support Sales and Service teams with technical sales activities, customer presentations and solution development. - Investigate technical issues, perform root cause analysis and develop recommendations to resolve customer challenges. - Deliver engineering support and applications to Service and Customer Operations teams across the assigned region. - Support customers through site visits, technical discussions and implementation activities where required. - Collaborate with the Training and Enablement team to deliver technical training for customers and employees. - Support product selection activities and provide engineering guidance for Safematic products globally. - Work closely with commercial, service, operations and engineering teams to ensure customer requirements are met. - Contribute to engineering projects and application requests, ensuring delivery within agreed timelines. - Participate in technical reviews, project meetings and customer-facing engineering discussions. Qualifications- Degree qualified Engineer (BEng, MEng or equivalent). - Strong understanding of engineering principles and application engineering methodologies. - Experience supporting customers through technical troubleshooting and solution development. - Commercial awareness with the ability to balance technical requirements and business objectives. - Proficiency with engineering and design software, including CAD and engineering simulation tools such as FEA and CFD. - Strong Microsoft Office skills. - Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities. - Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment. - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. - Self-motivated, proactive and capable of working independently. - Demonstrates ownership, accountability and a continuous improvement mindset. - English and Finnish language

title: Lähihoitaja kotihoitoon

title: KotiAvustajat - yrittäjä
description: KotiAvustajat ovat palvelleet asiakkaita 15 vuoden ajan Seinäjoella ja vuosien varrella laajentaneet toimintaansa Alavudelle, Ilmajoelle, Kuortaneelle, Kaustiselle, Veteliin, Hausjärvelle, Hyvinkäälle, Körkölään, Mäntsälään, Riihimäelle, Lempäälään, Nokialle, Pirkkalaan, Sastamalaan, Tampereelle, Ylöjärvelle, Helsinkiin, Espooseen, Kauniaisiin ja VantaalleHaemme itsenäisiä KotiAvustaja - yrittäjiä ympäri Suomen, jotka toimivat yhteistyössä KotiAvustajien kanssa uniikin toimintamallin mukaisesti omalla asuinpaikkakunnallaan.KotiAvustajana voit vaikuttaa omalla työlläsi siihen, että asuinpaikkakuntasi ikäihmiset saavat hyvää hoivaa ja huolenpitoa sekä konkreettista apua kotona asumiseen. KotiAvustajana autat ja huolehdit asiakkaan hyvinvoinnista antaen ohjausta terveydentilan ja toimintakyvyn ylläpitämiseksi. Kotikäynnit keskittyvät arkipäiviin ja sinulla on aikaa kohdata asiakas.Kaikki KotiAvustajat toimivat uniikin KotiAvustajat® brändin mukaisesti, joka luo paremmat toimintaedellytykset yrityksellesi sekä mahdollisuuden kehittyä paremmaksi osaajaksi. Asiakkuudet ovat pääsääntöisesti pitkäkestoisia ja se tuo turvaa yrittäjyyteen. Sinulla on hyvät mahdollisuudet erittäin hyviin ansioihin, joka luonnollisesti riippuu sinusta ja aktiivisuudestasi.Asiakastyötä tulet tekemään omalla persoonallasi ja täydellä sydämellä. Avoimuus, kyky kuunnella ja halu auttaa ovat tärkeimpiä ominaisuuksiasi. Lähtökohta toiminnallesi on hyvä asiakaspalvelu, jossa työtä teet aina asiakkaalle.Sinulla on terveysalan koulutus (esim. sairaanhoitaja, terveydenhoitaja, toimintaterapeutti, farmaseutti, fysioterapeutti jne.), hygieniapassi, auto omaan käyttöön sekä hallitset erinomaisesti suomen kielen.Saat yrittäjyyteen vankan tuen ja asiantuntevia neuvoja sekä ohjeita alkumetreiltä lähtien, "Liikkuvaan junaan" ja osaajien joukkoon on nyt helppo hypätä mukaan!

title: Public Relations Manager
description: **Employer:** Easpring Finland New Materials Oy**Location:** Kotka, Finland**About Easpring Finland**Easpring Finland is developing a battery materials plant in Kotka to meet the growing demand for battery materials in Europe. The plant will produce cathode active materials required for electric vehicle batteries.We are looking for an experienced public relations professional to lead the coordination of crisis communications, media relations, external stakeholder engagement and corporate communications during the Companys ramp-up and operational development.**Position Summary**As Public Relations Manager, you will serve as Easpring Finlands primary accountable owner for public relations and crisis communications, with responsibility for identifying emerging reputational risks, coordinating timely responses and maintaining clear, credible communications with external audiences.You will act as the Companys authorized spokesperson within defined mandates, develop relationships with media and external public stakeholders, and coordinate corporate and internal communications in cooperation with the CEO and relevant functions. In significant incidents, the role leads the public relations response while technical incident management, legal obligations and final corporate decisions remain with the responsible functions and authorized management.This role is suited to a senior communications professional who combines sound judgment under pressure, strong local networks and hands-on execution in an evolving industrial environment.**Key Responsibilities**- Act as the primary accountable owner for the Companys public relations crisis management and crisis communications, including early identification, assessment, response coordination and post-crisis reputation recovery. - Develop and maintain practical crisis communication protocols, escalation routes, spokesperson arrangements, holding statements and response materials in coordination with management and relevant business functions. - Lead and coordinate cross-functional public relations responses to significant incidents involving operations, occupational safety, employees, environmental matters or regulatory scrutiny, ensuring clear responsibilities, factual accuracy, timely escalation to the CEO and consistent external messaging, subject to required internal approvals. - Manage relationships with Finnish national, regional and local media; respond to enquiries and act as an authorized Company spokesperson within agreed mandates and approval procedures. - Prepare media briefings, key messages, questions and answers, statements and interview materials; advise management on sensitive media interactions and public positioning. - Build and maintain relationships with external non-shareholder stakeholders, including government ministries, public authorities, cities, municipalities, development agencies, industry organizations and local communities. - Coordinate external stakeholder engagement and public affairs activities, keeping appropriate records and supporting applicable transparency-related reporting requirements. - Develop and implement annual corporate communications plans, including the preparation of press releases, website content, social media updates, Company presentations and other external communications materials. - Maintain consistent messages and corporate identity across channels, coordinating external communications partners and ensuring required internal review before publication. - Coordinate internal communications on Company developments and significant events in cooperation with HR, HSE, Operations and other responsible functions, without replacing their subject-matter ownership. - Monitor media coverage, public sentiment and emerging reputational risks; assess implications, recommend preventative actions and provide concise updates to management. - Support stakeholder confidence and corporate reputation through proactive, accurate and consistent engagement; evaluate communication effectiveness and identify improvements. **Requirements**- Bachelors degree or higher in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Social Sciences, Business Administration or a related field. - At least 5 years of relevant experience in public relations, corporate communications, media relations or public affairs; substantial crisis communications experience is strongly preferred. - Proven ability to coordinate sensitive or high-profile public communications, manage competing demands and exercise sound judgment under pressure. - Excellent written and spoken Finnish and English, including the ability to communicate complex industrial or technical issues clearly to different audiences. - Strong experience working with journalists, public authorities, local communities and other external stakeholders; established Finnish networks are an advantage. - Understanding of the industrial, manufacturing, energy or battery materials sector is an advantage. - Strong writing, presentation, interviewing, stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills. - Ability to work independently, collaborate with senior management and cross-functional teams, and manage external professional partners. - High integrity, discretion, resilience and sensitivity when handling confidential or reputationally significant matters. **What We Offer**- Opportunity to join a fast-growing battery materials company - A visible role shaping crisis readiness, public trust and external engagement during a major industrial investment project - Opportunity to work with Company leadership and a wide network of Finnish external stakeholders - International working environment - Competitive compensation and benefits package Join us in our exciting journey ahead! We welcome talented individuals to be part of our team.

title: Procurement Engineer
description: **Employer**: Easpring Finland New Materials Oy**Location**: Kotka, Finland**About Easpring Finland**Easpring Finland is developing a battery materials plant in Kotka to meet the growing demand for battery materials in Europe. The plant will produce cathode active materials required for electric vehicle batteries.We are looking for a Procurement Engineer to manage local procurement activities and take overall responsibility for electricity procurement and energy management, supported by external professional service providers.**Position Summary**As Procurement Engineer, you will manage local procurement of goods and services and serve as the internal owner of Easpring Finlands electricity procurement and energy management activities. You will coordinate electricity price risk management and hedging, physical electricity procurement, consumption forecasting and efficiency initiatives, working closely with production, maintenance, sales, finance and external energy specialists.You will be accountable for coordinating energy management activities and translating specialist advice into actionable proposals, approved instructions, monitoring and follow-up. External strategic partners, currently including Fortum, will provide market insights, technical expertise and agreed services, while decisions and commitments remain subject to the Companys authorization and approval processes.This role offers the opportunity to combine hands-on procurement with the management of a major cost and operational risk area during the plants ramp-up and production expansion.**Key Responsibilities**- Manage local procurement of materials, equipment, spare parts and services, including sourcing, requests for quotation, supplier evaluation, negotiations, purchase orders, contracts and delivery follow-up. - Build and maintain relationships with local suppliers and support cost, quality, delivery, compliance and procurement process improvements. - Take overall responsibility for the Companys electricity procurement and energy management activities, coordinating internal stakeholders and external professional service providers to ensure effective implementation and performance. - Coordinate the development, implementation and periodic review of electricity procurement, price risk management and hedging policies and guidelines, in cooperation with external experts and relevant internal functions. - Manage commercial cooperation and contract discussions with the electricity strategic partner; prepare hedging proposals and coordinate necessary internal review and approvals before issuing authorized instructions. - Work with external specialists to assess Nordic electricity market developments and develop electricity price and cost outlooks for management and sales, supporting business planning and customer pricing. - Coordinate the procurement of Guarantees of Origin (GoO), including type and volume requirements received from sales, and ensure appropriate internal approvals and partner instructions. - Coordinate physical day-ahead and intraday electricity procurement with the strategic partner and operations team, based on plant production plans and expected electricity demand. - Monitor actual electricity consumption against forecasts and day-ahead orders, analyze deviations and balance power exposure, and coordinate corrective measures with operations and the service provider. - Develop electricity demand forecasts and consumption monitoring and reporting in cooperation with production, maintenance, sales and relevant technical teams. - Coordinate energy efficiency opportunities with production and maintenance teams, supporting analysis and implementation while operational teams retain responsibility for plant operations. - Establish clear communication routines for planned and unplanned production changes that may affect power consumption and short-term electricity procurement. - Manage external energy service providers, assess their professional recommendations, coordinate internal decisions and approved actions, monitor service performance and ensure timely escalation of significant energy-related risks. - Prepare regular reports on procurement performance, electricity cost forecasts, hedging status, consumption deviations and energy management risks; maintain appropriate records and comply with Company purchasing, financial authorization and compliance requirements. **Requirements**- Bachelors degree or higher in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Energy or a related field. - Practical experience in procurement, sourcing or supplier management, preferably in an industrial, manufacturing or energy-intensive environment. - Good understanding of procurement processes, supplier contracts, commercial negotiations and cost management. - Understanding of electricity procurement, the Nordic electricity market and energy price risk concepts, or a demonstrated ability to develop these competences with specialist support. - Ability to coordinate external energy experts and evaluate professional advice, with sound judgment on when to seek internal approvals or escalate risks. - Understanding of industrial electricity consumption, production planning and energy monitoring is an advantage. - Analytical skills and ability to work with forecasts, consumption data, costs and management reports. - Strong communication, negotiation, collaboration and problem-solving skills. - Professional proficiency in English; Finnish language skills are a strong advantage for local sourcing and supplier cooperation. **What We Offer**- Opportunity to join a fast-growing battery materials company - A key role combining local procurement with responsibility for a strategically important energy management area - Opportunity to work with experienced external energy professionals and cross-functional teams - International working environment - Competitive compensation and benefits package Join us in our exciting journey ahead! We welcome talented individuals to be part of our team.

title: Sourcing Analyst
description: _Established in 1878, Olvi Group is currently producing over billion liters of beverages yearly in different product groups: beers, soft drinks, mineral and vitamin waters, long drinks, sports and energy drinks, ciders and juices. We are proud of our broad product portfolio including our own brands and completed by international production and distribution partnerships. Our goal is to be the most wanted multi-local beverage house. We know the local consumers and markets, and launch hundreds of novelties each year.__Olvi Group employs over 2 500 professionals in nine different countries. Our head office is located in Iisalmi where it all began in 1878. We focus together on offering moments of enjoyment in consumers day to day life with our versatile high-quality products._**We are looking for a Sourcing Analyst to join Olvi Group and provide visibility and data-driven insights to support our sourcing and procurement processes.**As a Sourcing Analyst, **your responsibilities will include**:- Collecting, consolidating and analysing procurement data from various sources. - Developing procurement reporting, data quality, KPI metrics, dashboards and analytical tools. - Producing supplier- and category-specific analyses to support decision-making. - Identifying savings and development opportunities and preparing forecasts to support procurement needs. **To succeed in this role**, you should have a relevant university degree, and at least five years of relevant work experience. Previous experience working with procurement processes is considered an advantage.We are looking for someone who is motivated to develop data-driven decision-making and build solutions where data, analytics and automation help reduce manual work, including through the use of AI.The role requires strong analytical skills and the ability to process, combine and interpret large volumes of data and translate them into meaningful business insights. You should also have strong interpersonal and communication skills and be able to communicate effectively in English.A precise and systematic approach to work, together with the ability to adapt quickly to changing situations, will help you succeed in this role.**We offer** you an interesting and diverse role in an international and evolving listed company. We invest in the well-being of our people and provide a safe, inspiring, diverse and positive working environment. The position is permanent, and the starting date can be agreed upon. The location for this position might be either Helsinki or Iisalmi.**For further information** about the position, please contact Suvi Lehtonen at +358 50 458 4045. Phone enquiries are welcome on November 5th, 2026 from 16:00 to 17:00 and on November 17th, 2026 from 17:00 to 18:00, or by email at suvi.lehtonen@olvi.fi.Interested? **Submit your application** by November 15th, 2026!_Our values – local, positive, respectful and agile – are guiding our work and co-operation with each other and our stakeholders. Sustainability is part of our day-to-day operations through the value chain. On top of developing our own operations, we want to develop the beverage industry to be more sustainable by helping our partners, customers and consumers make sustainable choices. Our sustainability work is recognized internationally as the TIME magazine has included us twice (2024 and 2025) on the list of the worlds 500 most sustainable growth companies._

title: Legal Counsel / Senior Legal Counsel

You will be part of an international industrial environment where legal expertise plays an important role in supporting business decisions, managing risks and enabling sustainable growth.What makes this opportunity particularly interesting is the possibility to shape your own role.As part of our Legal team, your day-to-day work will include a variety of in-house legal matters, particularly drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements and providing practical legal advice to our businesses. In addition, depending on your experience, strengths and interests, you will take ownership of a defined area of responsibility within our Legal function and develop it further. This could include, for example, commercial contracts and business development, dispute resolution and risk management, environmental matters or other areas where your expertise can make a difference.We are looking for someone who not only enjoys solving legal questions but also wants to take initiative, develop ways of working and contribute to how legal support is delivered across the organisation.You will work closely with business stakeholders and colleagues across Nordics and different functions, and report directly to our Chief Legal Officer.What we are looking for- A Master of Laws degree and minimum 5 years of relevant experience in business law, preferably gained in an international business environment, a law firm or an in-house legal role- Strong legal expertise and the ability to provide practical, business-oriented advice- A proactive and independent approach, with the confidence to take ownership and drive matters forward- Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build trust and work effectively with different stakeholders- Excellent written and spoken Finnish and English; Swedish is considered as an advantage- Curiosity, a solution-oriented mindset and a genuine interest in developing both yourself and the way we workWe welcome applicants with different levels of experience. The final scope of responsibilities and position as Legal Counsel or Senior Legal Counsel will be determined based on the selected candidate's expertise and capabilities.What we offerAt Nordkalk, we believe that Legal should be more than a traditional support function. Our legal teams ambition is to be a trusted strategic partner to the business – proactive, approachable and focused on finding solutions. Our work is varied and fast-paced, and no two days are quite the same.We offer you:- Ownership and influence – the opportunity to take responsibility for your own area and develop it further- Variety and meaningful work – a broad range of legal and business matters in an international industrial environment- Room to grow – the possibility to develop professionally and shape your role based on your strengths and interests- A collaborative team – supportive colleagues, open communication and a low threshold for sharing ideas and asking questions- Flexibility – flexible working arrangements supporting a healthy balance between work and personal life- A chance to contribute to a brighter tomorrow – working in a company whose products play an important role in society and everyday lifeThe position is preferably based at our headquarters in Parainen (Turku region), but other locations, such as Lohja or Lappeenranta, may also be considered.For further information, please contact Chief Legal Officer Laura Määttänen, tel. +358 40 8374 570.Does this sound like your future job? Please send your application and CV by 16.11.2026 on www.nordkalk.fi / Ura Nordkalkissa / Avoimet työtehtävätAt Nordkalk, you can contribute to a brighter tomorrow with our limestone, which is vital for todays society and our everyday lives. It nurtures the ground that feeds us, purifies the water we drink, the air we breathe, and keeps various businesses thriving. Our success is built on a solid limestone foundation, more than 125 years of expertise and our proud and committed people. With operations in more than 30 locations in Europe, we are always near our customers. Nordkalks owner is UK-based SigmaRoc PLC. #rocksolidprofessionals #brightertomorrow

title: Technical Sales Manager, Finland / Nordic region
description:
Are you ready to grow a business and make a difference in plant health?

Lallemand Plant Care is looking for a commercially driven and technically skilled Technical Sales Manager to lead business development across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.

This is an exciting opportunity for a professional who combines a passion for agriculture and plant health with strong sales capabilities and a strategic business mindset. You will play a key role in expanding Lallemands market presence and bringing innovative microorganism-based plant protection and biofertilizer products to distributors, growers and industry partners.

Your role and key responsibilities

 * Principle contact to sales for Lallemand Plant Care customers in assigned territory.
 * Take ownership of the annual sales budget and maximize sales growth.
 * Build and strengthen long-term relationships with existing and new customers.
 * Lead commercial negotiations with distributors, strategic partners and key accounts.
 * Identify new business opportunities, monitor market trends and translate customer needs into growth opportunities.
 * Collaborate with sales, marketing, regulatory and field solutions teams to ensure consistent market offering and high customer satisfaction.
 * Report on business development and sales performance regularly to the Commercial Director.

Be a trusted technical partner

 * Manage and provide technical support to customers, including support for product demonstrations and field trials.
 * Deliver customer training and technical presentations, helping customers understand product performance and best practices.
 * Represent Lallemand Plant Care at industry events, trade shows and professional forums.

What will help you succeed?

We are looking for an experienced professional who understands the micro-organism-based solutions market and knows how to turn technical expertise into commercial success.

You will ideally bring:

 * A bachelors or masters degree in agricultural sciences or a related field. Additional qualifications in business, management or plant protection are an advantage.
 * At least 10 years of relevant professional experience, including proven success in technical sales and business development within the agricultural input sector.
 * A strong understanding of agricultural markets, distribution channels and commercial business practices.
 * Excellent sales, negotiation and business development skills.
 * An established network within the agricultural input industry is an advantage.
 * Fluency in English and Swedish – Finnish and other Scandinavian language skills are a bonus.
 * Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools.

In addition

You are likely to thrive in this role if you are:

 * Entrepreneurial and self-motivated, with a strong drive to achieve results.
 * Adaptable and curious, willing to learn quickly and embrace new challenges.
 * Collaborative and communicative, able to build trust with customers and colleagues.
 * Reliable and honest, with a strong work ethic and a commitment to delivering on promises.

What to expect

 * A regional role with responsibility for business growth across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.
 * The opportunity to combine commercial leadership with technical expertise in plant care.
 * Close collaboration with customers, distributors and cross-functional teams.
 * A hybrid working arrangement.
 * Travel of up to approximately 50% of working time, mainly within Nordic territory, with occasional international travel for training and meetings.

A valid passport and driving license are required. The role also involves occasional visits to agricultural, field and factory environments.

How to get more information about the position 

For further information about the position, please email professional@visiohr.fi  or contact Visio Professionals Talent Managers Sanna Majava, tel. +358 45 860 7556 or Tarja Laakso, tel. +358 45 858 8441.

About Lallemand Plant Care

Lallemand is a privately held Canadian company founded in the late 19th century, which develops, produces, and markets microorganisms for various markets. Lallemand Plant Care brings value to growers through innovative microorganism-based solutions for agriculture, horticulture, forestry, and turf. From selecting the right strains to delivering high-quality products and application expertise, we focus on solutions growers can trust. Our broad portfolio is designed to integrate easily into existing practices and address specific challenges. Read more: Lallemand Plant Care  or Lallemand Finland Oy 

Visio Professional

Visio Professional is a recruitment company specialising in professional and white-collar recruitment. It is part of the Visio Group, established in 2020. We are constantly looking for talented professionals across a wide range of industries and experience levels, from entry-level positions to senior roles. We take a personal approach to recruitment and strive to find solutions that benefit both candidates and employers. Whether you are at the beginning of your career or an experienced professional, we are here to help you find a role that matches your skills and expertise.

title: Technical Property Manager, Marine & Ports

Our sustainable solutions have a far-reaching impact, and by joining us you will actively play a part in contributing to a more sustainable future. www.abb.com/newsWe offer an international and dynamic working environment where our business delivers advanced technology in large projects across the world in a customer-oriented and highly globalized industry.Our culture and benefits reflect our values: courage, care, curiosity and collaboration. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.Ready to make an impact?Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Lead Electrical Engineer
description: Are you an electrical engineer who wants to be the one who decides how an automation system is built, not just the one who draws it?This role is built for engineers who want to own the electrical side of a project from the first customer conversation to the final sign-off. You define the system architecture, size and specify the components, design the solution in Eplan, and then follow it through the build: reviewing the installation in our own Vantaa facility and, when the system is ready, supporting commissioning on site.You will work side by side with a tight-knit automation team of PLC engineers, mechanical designers and installers. They build and program what you design, and you stay close enough to the shop floor to see how your design performs in practice. Our projects live under Etteplan's delivery umbrella, so you get the engineering depth of a large organization together with the full weight and satisfaction of an end-to-end project.If you have years of industrial electrical design behind you, know Eplan inside out, and want technical leadership without leaving hands-on engineering, this is the seat for you. Each project brings something new: PLCs, robotics, AMRs and data systems integrated into complete customer solutions.Deep expertise, genuine ownership, and the kind of variety that keeps the work interesting. That is what we are offering.Key Responsibilities - Define the electrical and automation system architecture together with customers and the project team - Lead the electrical design of automation systems in Eplan, and maintain Eplan standards, macros and templates - Integrate PLCs, drives, robots, AMRs, safety and network devices into complete solutions - Specify components with suppliers and size the system: power, protection, cabling and cabinet thermal design - Supervise installation and wiring in our Vantaa facility and on customer sites, and support FAT, commissioning and troubleshooting - Ensure standards compliance and documentation (e.g. SFS-EN IEC 60204-1, IEC 61439, EMC), and guide and review the work of other electrical designersWhat We Expect from You - M.Sc. or B.Sc. (or equivalent) in electrical engineering or automation - Solid experience (typically 8+ years) of electrical design for industrial automation, machinery or production lines - Deep Eplan expertise; Pro Panel and macro automation are a plus - Experience in system architecture and electrical sizing, and good understanding of PLC systems (Siemens, Beckhoff or B&R) and industrial networks - Hands-on understanding of installation work: you can read a cabinet on the shop floor and find the fault - Leadership attitude: ability to guide others and make well-founded technical decisions - Interest in robotics, AMRs and simulation is a plus - Fluency in English and Finnish - Willingness to travel occasionally and ability to work regularly on site in VantaaThis is a permanent, full-time position. Applicants must have valid authorization to work in Finland. Please note that Etteplan does not provide relocation support or compensation.At Etteplan we ensure that your compensation is fair and transparent. Your salary reflects your competencies and contributions. For this role, the typical monthly salary is 4800–5500 €/month, depending on your background.Sounds like the right opportunity for you? Please submit your application through our recruitment system by end of November at the latest. For more information about the role, you can contact Director Jari Luotonen, jari.luotonen@etteplan.com.

title: (Senior) Legal Counsel @ Finnfund
description: **Hey lawyer!**Would you like to contribute to shaping a more sustainable future? Would you like to help drive sustainable growth and create opportunities through investments in developing countries?We are now looking for **a (Senior) Legal Counsel** to join **Finnfund's** team. This is a full-time, permanent position based in Helsinki._Finnfund is a Finnish development financier and impact investor. Finnfund builds a sustainable future and generates lasting impact by investing in businesses that solve global development challenges with Finnish added value. Each year, Finnfund invests 200–250 million euros in 20–30 companies in developing countries. Finnfund's focus is particularly on digital infrastructure and solutions, clean energy, forestry, agriculture, and on providing funding for small and medium-sized enterprises through financial institutions. Today, Finnfund's investments, commitments, and investment decisions total about 1.2 billion euros. Finnfund has about 100 employees based in Helsinki and Nairobi. For more information, please visit the company's website at https://www.finnfund.fi/en/._Finnfund is mandated to provide long-term financing for economically feasible private sector projects in emerging markets. Finnfund's financing is channelled either as debt, equity, or mezzanine instruments and they also invest through private equity funds.**As a (Senior) Legal Counsel,** you will act as a member of project teams and identify, assess, and manage legal risks related to projects. You will oversee project documentation and legal matters, coordinate external legal assignments, and provide support on responsible taxation.You will also assist with other legal matters, including internal decision-making processes and approval levels. You will maintain and develop the legal function by, amongst other things, keeping up to date with regulations related to project work and communicating new or revised regulations to project teams and, when needed, by participating in implementing such regulations into Finnfund's processes. You will also participate in drafting and updating templates and guidelines and other development work of Finnfund's operations.The role offers opportunities to contribute to diverse projects and legal matters beyond the core responsibilities outlined above. You will join a ten-person Legal Affairs team and report to the Director of Legal Affairs.**This position is a great fit for a lawyer who:**- has a Master of Laws degree (preferably Finnish or English) or an equivalent legal degree and a minimum of 5 years of applicable professional experience from either a law firm or a financial institution. Please note that applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in Helsinki (Finland). Due to time constraints, Finnfund is unable to sponsor work permits or support relocation-related immigration processes for this role; - has experience in debt financing - expertise in complex restructuring situations would be considered an advantage. Experience in cross-border transactions, equity investments and/or project finance would also be an asset; - is proactive, has excellent teamwork skills, takes full ownership of their work, and can work independently under time pressure; - has excellent IT skills, which are essential in today's hybrid working environment; and - has excellent writing and communication skills in English – fluency in other languages and international experience are considered assets. **What Finnfund offers you:****Work that makes a difference**: Finnfund's mission is to build a sustainable future and generate lasting impact by investing in businesses that solve global development challenges with Finnish added value. Their vision is that people and the Planet are at the core of every investment decision.**Challenging yet rewarding role:** You'll step into a role where you'll contribute to exciting and challenging international projects as part of a multinational team.**A modern office space in Helsinki**: The office has been designed in collaboration with Finnfund's employees. While everyone has their own desk at the office, the hybrid working model allows employees to work from home 1–2 days a week.**Benefits to support your wellbeing:** Finnfund promotes employees' well-being, work-life balance, and job satisfaction by offering flexible working hours, extensive occupational health care services, and recreational activities. Finnfund also motivates its employees to take care of their well-being and health by supporting their sports and cultural activities. Employees can also benefit from an employer-subsidised commuter benefit.**Did we pique your interest?**If this sounds like your next career move, please get the conversation going by sending us your CV and cover letter by clicking the Apply now button by **15 November 2026**! If you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact our Senior Recruiter Olivia Yli-Pelkonen (+358 40 769 5401 or olivia.yli-pelkonen@minjon.fi) from November 9 onwards.If you have a disability and require assistance during the recruiting process, please get in touch with the contact person mentioned above. When needed, Finnfund can adjust the process according to your need for support. We encourage applications from qualified individuals from a wide range of backgrounds. Finnfund is committed to having a team that is made up of diverse skills, experiences, and abilities.

title: Train for a New Career as an HSE Professional
description: **How would you like the opportunity to train for a new career while working in permanent employment?**This opportunity is ideal for a technical professional with a strong motivation to pursue a career in construction site safety.The training recruitment programme will begin in late 2026, and two candidates will be selected. The selected candidates will be offered permanent employment, including the required training and practical on-site induction with the support of the site organisation.**What will you be doing?**In this role, you will participate in the day-to-day monitoring of safety on the construction site. You will review the risks associated with different work phases together with employees and site management, participate in safety inspections and document observations made on site. You will monitor the implementation of agreed safety measures and help ensure that all work is carried out safely and in accordance with the sites requirements.Your duties will also include preparing and updating risk assessments, conducting pre-work inspections for upcoming activities and managing safety documentation. As your training progresses and your expertise develops, you will take a more independent role in preparing RAMS documentation and method statements, as well as participating in site safety and coordination meetings. You will work closely with site management, other contractors and the principal contractor.**What do we expect from you?**The position is suitable for candidates with a relevant bachelors degree in Construction Engineering or Construction Site Management, together with practical experience in the construction industry. Previous experience in a dedicated HSE role is not required, but we expect you to have a practical understanding of construction site safety and a strong motivation to train and develop into an HSE professional.At the beginning of your employment, you will complete an OSHA Construction Safety course delivered in English. The course will provide you with the knowledge and skills required to work in construction site safety. As your expertise and experience develop, you will have the opportunity to complete the NEBOSH International General Certificate and progress towards more demanding HSE responsibilities.You will need a good command of English, as you will work in an international environment, prepare safety documentation and complete the initial safety training in English. We expect you to have a systematic and responsible approach to your work, strong attention to detail and the confidence to address any safety issues you identify in a constructive manner.**What do we offer?**We offer permanent employment through Biisoni and a long-term role on a major project in Seinäjoki. You will have the opportunity to build a new career in construction site safety and develop your expertise through professional training, practical induction and the support of an experienced organisation. Your responsibilities will expand as your training progresses and your expertise develops.Your salary will be agreed based on your qualifications, previous experience and the level of responsibility at the beginning of the role. Your salary will be reviewed as you complete the required training and develop in the role.You will receive comprehensive induction covering the sites operating practices, safety requirements, documentation and systems. Please submit your application through the application link as soon as possible, but no later than 19 November 2026. title: Ekonomi- och verksamhetscontroller
description: Som ekonomi- och verksamhetscontroller har du en bred och omväxlande roll där ekonomi, redovisning, fastighetsadministration och verksamhetsstöd möts. Du arbetar med den löpande ekonomihanteringen för våra olika enheter och delar ansvaret för redovisningen med övriga inom ekonomiavdelningen. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår bland annat leverantörs- och kundreskontra, fakturering, avstämningar, moms- och skattedeklarationer samt medverkan i kvartals- och årsbokslut och administration av våra bostadsaktiebolag.En viktig del av uppdraget är också att fungera som controller och administrativt stöd för organisationens verksamheter. I takt med verksamhetens utveckling kan tjänsten även komma att omfatta stöd till Folkhälsan på Ålands lokalföreningar. Du följer upp verksamheternas ekonomi, nyckeltal och resursanvändning samt tar fram analyser, rapporter och beslutsunderlag som stöd för planering och uppföljning. Du fungerar som ett stöd för chefer i ekonomiska och administrativa frågor och bidrar till att utveckla och effektivisera rutiner och arbetssätt.För att trivas i rollen behöver du vara strukturerad, noggrann och självgående. Du har god analytisk förmåga och tycker om att arbeta med både detaljer och helheter. Arbetet innebär många kontaktytor och varierande uppgifter, vilket förutsätter god samarbetsförmåga, flexibilitet och ett serviceinriktat arbetssätt.Vi söker dig som har en tradenom examen eller annan lämplig högskoleutbildning inom ekonomi samt erfarenhet av bokföring och redovisning. Du har god datorvana, är trygg i att arbeta med ekonomiska underlag och har intresse för verksamhetsuppföljning och utveckling. Vi fäster stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.Tjänsten är ett moderskapsvikariat på heltid, cirka 12 månader. Då organisationen är under utveckling och tjänstens ansvarsområde kan komma att utökas finns möjlighet till förlängning eller fortsatt anställning efter vikariatets slut.Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Intervjuer kan ske löpande under rekryteringsperioden.Folkhälsan är en rökfri arbetsplats.

title: Early Childhood Education Teacher (recruitment from abroad, permanent position in public sector daycare))
description: Hello, Early Childhood Education Teachers! Are you interested in working in a public daycare in Finland, known for its high-quality education system? We offer a permanent full-time position, competitive salary, great employee benefits, free Finnish language training, apartment, relocation support, and a clear pathway to living and working in Finland. Whether you are an experienced Early Childhood Education Teacher or newly qualified, we at the City of Helsinki would be delighted to hear from you!In Finland, ECE teachers are highly trusted professionals. You have significant autonomy in planning pedagogical activities and are encouraged to use your professional expertise in everyday work. You support the holistic development of children aged 0-6 in an inclusive, child-centred environment. You work in a multi-professional team, sharing responsibility for childrens wellbeing and learning.In Finland, ECE is part of the national education system and follows the Educare model, integrating care, education and teaching (read more from the Finnish National Agency for Education: https://www.oph.fi/en/education-system/early-childhood-education-and-care-finland). In practice, this means that: Every moment is pedagogical Play is the foundation of learning Learning happens throughout the whole day Nature and outdoor environments are used yearround Childrens interests and questions guide learningYour core responsibilities: Plan, implement and assess play-based learning activities Lead your groups pedagogical work together with childcare nurses Observe and document childrens learning and development Create and update individual learning plans in collaboration with families Collaborate with colleagues and multidisciplinary professionals Design inspiring learning environments indoors and outdoorsOur daycare units' opening hours range between 6:15-17:30, depending on families needs. As a full-time teacher you work 38.25 hours per week Monday-Friday.We are looking for professionals who connect well with others and are open to learning and professional growth. You value teamwork and recognise that high-quality pedagogy is built together. You will enjoy this role if you want to fully use your pedagogical expertise and appreciate professional trust and autonomy. You are an advocate of play-based learning and see learning opportunities in everyday moments. As a professional you are reflective, curious and resilient.Qualification and other requirements to start the Finnish language course in February 2027: Right to work in Finland, for example, on the basis of EU/EEA citizenship At least Bachelors degree in Early Childhood Education Your qualification gives you the right to work as an Early Childhood Education Teacher for children aged 0-6 years in the country where the degree was obtained. At least level B2 in English language Willingness and ability to commit to learning Finnish language prior to employment contract and relocation. The working language in our daycares is Finnish. During the language course we test your language skill development regularly. Requirements to enter into a permanent employment contract in January 2028: Reaching target level B1 in Finnish language Decision from the Finnish National Agency of Education demonstrating eligibility to work as an ECE teacher in Finland Criminal record extract from the Legal Register Centre Proof that you do not have respiratory tuberculosis We can only enter into a permanent employment contract with you if you meet all the above requirements.We provide comprehensive support to make your relocation to Finland as smooth as possible: Assistance with degree recognition process Remote Finnish language training (10 months, part-time, 4x90min lessons every week + 4-8h/wk independent study, homework and assignments) which you can complete alongside your current employment Pre-departure training also includes practical information about working and living in Finland Support in registrations with Finnish authorities upon arrival (also for relocating family members) Assistance in finding an apartment. As a City of Helsinki employee, you can rent a City-owned apartment and no rental deposit is required.Language training and relocation schedule: Feb'27-Dec'27: Finnish language training remotely. Attendance and active participation is essential. Jan'28: Relocation to Finland and starting work.Salary and benefits: Starting salary: €3,298/mth +3-8% experience-based supplements for 5-10 yrs of relevant experience ePassi benefit: €550/year (sports, culture, wellbeing, commuting) Comprehensive private occupational health care Paid annual leave: 23-28 days + 5 extra days for qualified teachers Holiday bonus pay Watch our teachers who have already relocated share their experiences of pedagogical work, life in Finland, and the support they received in the relocation process: Álvaro and Eva: https://youtu.be/KhcaHeu-xLc Melissa: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6eyjJjnxRiY Yaiza: https://youtu.be/4IPA8d0pkI4We warmly welcome you to join a workplace that values your expertise and recognises the potential in both you and the children!Please note:(ENG) If you are already living in Finland and hold a degree in early childhood education obtained abroad, please do not apply through this path. Instead, explore our other employment opportunities at www.helsinkirekry.fi and https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals or contact us at rekry.kasko@hel.fi.(FIN) Jos asut jo Suomessa ja sinulla on ulkomailla suoritettu varhaiskasvatuksen tutkinto, älä hae tähän polkuun. Tutustu sen sijaan muihin työpaikkoihimme osoitteessa www.helsinkirekry.fi ja työllistymispolkuihimme osoitteessa https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals, tai ota meihin yhteyttä: rekry.kasko@hel.fi.

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja
description: AML-Palvelut Oy on vuodesta 2002 toiminut perheomisteinen yritys, joka tarjoaa laadukkaita avustaja-, kotihoito- ja sairaanhoitopalveluita. Yritys on sitoutunut tarjoamaan asiakkailleen kokonaisvaltaista hoivaa ja huolenpitoa, ottaen huomioon yksilölliset tarpeet ja toiveet.Tule meille osaava henkilökohtainen avustaja - meillä on tarjota sinulle lämminhenkinen ja sosiaalinen tiimi mukavassa työympäristössä. Etsimme sosiaalisia taitoja omaavaa henkilöä, voit myös olla jo eläkkeellä. Ymmärrämme, että osaaminen ei katso ikää vaan arvostamme monipuolista elämän kokemustasi.Työyhteisömme arvostaa hyviä sosiaalisia taitoja, sillä asiakkaamme ansaitsevat aitoa kohtaamista ja välittämistä. Arvostamme asiakaslähtöisyyttä ja haluamme tarjota parasta mahdollista huolenpitoa. Sinulla on mahdollisuus tehdä työtä itsenäisesti ja toivommekin, että pystyt tarttumaan vastuullisesti erilaisiin tehtäviin.Haemme avustajaa keikkatyöhön arkisin sekä viikonloppuihin. Työaika on päivästä riippuen klo 8-18 välillä. Otamme myös huomioon toiveesi työaikojen suhteen. Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen palkan ja monipuolisen työnkuvan, jossa jokainen päivä on erilainen.Jos olet motivoitunut sekä positiivinen, että haluat olla osa lämminhenkistä ja kehittyvää tiimiämme, lähetä meille hakemuksesi CV:n kera osoitteeseen anne.lindholm@amlpalvelut.fi. Lisätietoja voit tiedustella samasta osoitteesta.Onhan sinulla ajokortti ja auto käytössäsi, sillä asiakkaame asuvat kotonaTule mukaan luomaan merkityksellisiä hetkiä ja auttamaan ihmisiä parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla!

title: CHEF EQUIPE DEMOLITION (H/F)
description: L'agence MENCO Brest recrutePour l'un de ses clients spécialisé dans les travaux de déconstruction, démolition et sciage-carottage, nous recherchons un Chef d'équipe Démolition H/F pour intervenir sur différents chantiers dans le Nord Finistère.Vous aurez pour mission de piloter vos chantiers en autonomie, d'organiser le travail de votre équipe et de participer directement aux travaux.Vous n'êtes pas issu.e de la démolition ? Les profils expérimentés en Travaux Publics, conduite d'engins ou secteur agricole peuvent également nous intéresser.Vos missionsPréparer et organiser les chantiers avec le chargé d'affairesAnticiper les besoins en matériel, matériaux et évacuation des déchetsOrganiser et répartir le travail de votre équipeVeiller au respect des règles de sécurité sur le chantierParticiper directement aux travaux de déconstruction et démolitionConduire les engins nécessaires aux travaux, notamment mini-pelle et robot de démolitionParticiper aux travaux de sciage-carottage selon vos compétencesSuivre l'avancement du chantier et faire remonter les besoins ou difficultés rencontréesAssurer le lien avec le chargé d'affaires et les interlocuteurs présents sur le chantierAccompagner et former les nouveaux collaborateursProfil recherchéVous possédez idéalement une expérience en démolition, déconstruction, sciage-carottage ou gros œuvre.Nous sommes également ouverts à des profils issus des Travaux Publics ou du milieu agricole, habitués à la conduite d'engins et disposant d'une réelle autonomie sur le terrain.- Savoir organiser votre travail et celui d'une petite équipe.- Faire preuve d'habileté manuelle, de polyvalence, - Etre en capacité de participer directement aux travaux.- Une expérience en conduite de mini-pelle est particulièrement appréciée.Permis B obligatoire.Le permis BE ainsi que les CACES R482 et R486 constituent des plus. Ces qualifications figurent également parmi celles appréciées par l'entreprise dans son annonce. Votre intégrationUne journée de découverte de l'entreprise est prévue à votre arrivée.Vous serez accompagné.e avant de prendre vos chantiers en autonomie.Des formations pourront être financées afin de vous permettre de monter en compétences, notamment CACES, SST et travail en hauteur. ConditionsPoste sur le Nord Finistère, avec déplacements sur différents chantiersPoste à responsabilités avec autonomie sur chantierRémunération selon profil et expériencePanier repas et indemnités de déplacement selon les conditions applicables

title: Technicien de maintenance des bâtiments (H/F)
description: Vous êtes Technicien de maintenance et souhaitez intégrer un environnement hospitalier dynamique et humain ? Rejoignez notre établissement afin d'assurer la maintenance des installations techniques, contribuer à la sécurité des équipements et garantir la continuité de service indispensable au bon fonctionnement de l'hôpital.Rattaché(e) au service technique, vous assurez la maintenance préventive et curative des installations de l'établissement. Vous participez également au suivi des travaux, à la coordination des entreprises extérieures et à la réalisation des interventions nécessaires au maintien en conditions opérationnelles des infrastructures.MISSIONS :- Assurer la maintenance préventive et curative des installations techniques de l'établissement.- Intervenir sur les installations électriques selon vos habilitations, diagnostiquer les pannes et réaliser les réparations nécessaires.- Garantir la remise en service des équipements et contribuer au maintien des installations critiques.- Veiller au respect des normes techniques, réglementaires et des règles de sécurité applicables en milieu hospitalier.- Participer aux contrôles réglementaires et à la prévention des risques techniques.- Coordonner les interventions des entreprises extérieures, contrôler la qualité et la conformité des travaux réalisés.- Réaliser des devis, assurer le suivi administratif et technique des interventions et proposer des solutions adaptées aux besoins de l'établissement.- Effectuer des petits travaux tous corps d'état (électricité, second œuvre, maintenance courante).- Assurer la gestion du stock de pièces détachées : suivi des inventaires, réapprovisionnement et maintien d'un stock minimum garantissant la continuité d'activité.- Participer aux astreintes techniques selon le planning défini et intervenir en cas d'incident impactant la sécurité ou l'activité de l'établissement.- Renseigner les fiches d'intervention, assurer la traçabilité des actions réalisées et mettre à jour les documents techniques.- Participer à l'amélioration continue des installations et des organisations techniques.PROFIL RECHERCHÉ :Titulaire d'une formation technique de type CAP, BEP, Bac Pro, BTS ou équivalent dans le domaine de la maintenance, de l'électricité ou des métiers du bâtiment, vous disposez idéalement d'une expérience en maintenance technique.Vous maîtrisez les bases de la maintenance des installations, notamment électriques, et disposez des habilitations électriques nécessaires ainsi que de la qualification SSIAP obligatoire.Rigoureux(se), autonome et réactif(ve), vous savez diagnostiquer une situation, prendre des décisions adaptées et intervenir efficacement face aux imprévus. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et êtes reconnu(e) pour votre sens du service, votre fiabilité et votre respect des règles de sécurité.INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES :Les petits + :- Prime annuelle et prime d'embauche à l'issue de la période d'essai.- Prime de fidélisation dès 3 ans d'ancienneté.- Parking salarié gratuit.- Avantages CSE : tarifs culture, cartes cadeaux, chèques vacances et autres bons plans.- Accès à un self de qualité avec tarifs négociés.- Participation aux astreintes techniques garantissant la continuité de service 24h/24.Processus de recrutement :- Entretien téléphonique initial avec la personne chargée du recrutement afin d'échanger sur votre parcours et vos motivations.- Entretien complémentaire avec le recrutement et le responsable technique afin d'approfondir votre expérience et vous présenter l'environnement de travail.Prêt(e) à rejoindre une équipe technique engagée ? Venez mettre vos compétences au service d'un établissement où la qualité des installations contribue directement à la sécurité des patients et des professionnels. Nous serons ravis de découvrir votre parcours et d'échanger avec vous.

title: Opérateur tunnelier(H/F)
description: Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité, nous recherchons pour notre client, un opérateur tunnelier. Vous interviendrez dans le cadre du marché pour la nouvelle ligne de métro.Vous serez amené(e)s à :- Participer aux travaux de creusement en souterrain à l'aide d'un tunnelier + montage du tunnelier - Décharger les convois pour alimenter en matériel les zones du tunnel - Participer à l'approvisionnement et à l'installation des voussoirs - Participer aux injections de bourrage du vide annulaire - Participer à l'allongement des convoyeurs et de toute alimentation - Contribuer à la qualité des tâches en s'autocontrôlant, faire remonter à sa hiérarchie les bonnes informations et alerter en cas de dysfonctionnement -Travailler en équipe pour garantir la bonne avancée des travaux- Assurer le bon fonctionnement du tunnelier- Respecter les consignes de sécurité sur le chantierVous disposerez aussi des avantages CRIT : - Taux horaire fixe + 10% fin de mission + 10% congés payés.- Compte Epargne Temps Pour ce poste d'opérateur tunnelier, nous recherchons un.e candidat.e possédant les compétences et formations suivantes :- Capacité à utiliser les équipements de forage et de creusement- Connaissance des consignes de sécurité sur les chantiers- Aptitude au travail en équipe- Polyvalence et réactivité face aux situations imprévuesSi vous êtes motivé.e par les métiers du BTP et que vous souhaitez vous investir dans une mission enrichissante, n'hésitez pas à postuler dès maintenant !

Votre mission est essentielle pour mener à bien l'activité de notre client.Ce job se situe à Verneuil-d'Avre-et-d'Iton (27). Le rythme de travail pour cette mission sera du lundi soir au samedi matin en horaires de nuit soit de 21H00 à 05H00 et/ou du samedi soir au lundi matin en horaires de nuit soit de 17H00 à 05H00.Avantages de la mission:- Primes diverses ;- Tickets restaurant ;- Mission longue ;- Acomptes dès le 1er jour travaillé ;- Une épargne salariale rémunérée à 10 % ;- Une prime de 100€ dès 3 mois de placement sur le CET. Ce job se situe à Mantes La Ville Le rythme de travail pour cette mission sera travail en équipes alternantes, possibilité Nuit et Samedi et Dimanche  5h30 - 13h02 /13h02 - 20h34 / 20h34 - 5h30Avantages de la mission: - Acomptes dès le 1er jour travaillé- Une épargne rémunérée à 10%- Une prime de 100€ dès 3 mois de placement sur le CET Directement rattaché au responsable de production, vous assurez les tâches suivantes :   - Vous êtes le/la référent(e) technique sur le métier du tournage à commande numérique et réalisez des opérations d'usinage ainsi que des productions en autonomie sur différents métiers techniques.- Vous analysez et interprétez les résultats des contrôles statistiques afin de contribuer à l'amélioration de la qualité et des performances des process de fabrication.- Vous concevez et réalisez des pièces prototypes en lien avec les services méthodes grâce à la programmation conversationnelle.- Vous maîtrisez les procédés et moyens spécifiques à forte valeur ajoutée tels que la pose d'hélicoïl et les opérations de pointage, tout en participant à l'optimisation des programmes et process avec les équipes méthodes.- Vous accompagnez et formez les nouveaux arrivants et participez à la validation de leur qualification pratique.- Vous diagnostiquez les dérives et aléas techniques afin d'orienter les actions de maintenance préventive et mettez en œuvre des outils d'analyse et d'amélioration continue tels que le 5P, le SMED et le chrono-simogramme. description: En tant qu'équipier support H/F en agence, vous jouez un rôle essentiel dans la remise des colis auprès des particuliers. title: Opérateur / Opératrice de fabrication des industries chimiques (H/F)
description: Nous recherchons pour notre client acteur dans l'aéronautique des Opérateurs ou Opératrices de fabrication  (F/H) pour une mission longue durée.Sous la responsabilité du chef d'atelier, votre mission sera d'effectuer des opérations de transformations de pièces.  Le rythme de travail pour cette mission sera en journée 2x8Ce job se situe à Saint-Crépin-Ibouvillers.Avantages de la mission- Acomptes dès le 1er jour travaillé - Une épargne rémunérée à 10%- Une prime de 100€ dès 3 mois de placement sur le CET- Prime Panier- Prime equipe- 13eme mois- Prime habillement  Sous la responsabilité du chef d'atelier, votre mission sera d'effectuer des opérations de transformations de pièces.Votre MISSION sera de produire les pièces conformes selon les procédures en vigueur en respectant les engagements de qualité, coûts, délais. Préparation et mise en oeuvre des procédures de production :- Organiser la production en recherchant et traitant les informations nécessaires.- Évaluer et assurer la disponibilité des matières premières, outillages, et équipements conformes aux ordres de fabrication.- Identifier les points critiques de fabrication et remonter les écarts.- Comprendre et appliquer les gammes de fabrication spécifiques à chaque pièce.Réalisation de la Production :- Vérifier la correspondance entre l'ordre de fabrication (OF) et la fiche suiveuse.- Draper la pièce- Contrôler la qualité des opérations via des vérifications techniques et visuelles- Enregistrer les données de production et les anomalies pour assurer la traçabilité.- Détecter et signaler tout dysfonctionnement ou incident, et suivre les consignes dérogatoires en cas de problème. Idéalement, Vous avez déja travaillé dans un environnement de PME. Vous savez vous adapter à des règles de fabrications en petites et moyennes séries en utilisation plusieurs type de matériaux (bois / métal / tissu).

public.Vous intégrerez un environnement SI à forts enjeux de disponibilité et interviendrez sur un périmètre d'environ 40 solutions numériques.Votre rôle sera de piloter la gestion des incidents majeurs et des problèmes afin de garantir un retour au service nominal rapide, d'identifier les causes racines des dysfonctionnements et d'éviter leur récurrence.À ce titre, vos principales missions seront : * Piloter et animer les cellules de crise lors d'incidents ayant un impact sur la disponibilité des services. * Mobiliser et coordonner les différents acteurs techniques et métiers jusqu'au rétablissement du service. * Faciliter la communication entre les différentes équipes pendant les incidents. * Participer aux revues post-incidents et assurer le suivi des actions correctives identifiées. * Identifier et analyser les causes racines des incidents récurrents. * Formaliser les problèmes, les affecter aux équipes concernées et suivre leur résolution. * Réaliser un suivi hebdomadaire des logs techniques via Dynatrace. * Informer les équipes produit de l'évolution des dysfonctionnements constatés. * Suivre et restituer les indicateurs liés à la satisfaction utilisateurs et identifier les causes des variations. * Analyser les remontées issues de l'OBEYA et piloter les plans d'actions associés. * Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la disponibilité et de la qualité des services SI.Vous disposez d'une expérience significative en Incident Management et/ou Problem Management, idéalement acquise au sein d'une DSI ou d'un environnement de production informatique complexe.Vous maîtrisez notamment : * Incident Management * Problem Management * Gestion et coordination d'incidents majeurs * Animation de cellules de crise * Analyse des causes racines / RCA * Revues post-incidents et suivi des plans d'actions * Processus et bonnes pratiques ITIL * Pilotage de KPI et qualité de serviceUne connaissance de Dynatrace et/ou d'outils de supervision/APM constitue un véritable plus.Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre leadership, votre capacité à fédérer différents interlocuteurs, votre communication et votre capacité à garder une vision structurée dans des situations critiques. Les avantages du modèle JOCADEn rejoignant JOCAD IT, vous bénéficiez d'un environnement structuré et attentif au bien-être des collaborateurs : * Mutuelle & Prévoyance familiales complètes * Tickets restaurant (Swile) * Prime Vacances Syntec * Plan de développement des compétences pour accompagner votre évolution * Nombreuses offres CSE via Club Employés (réductions, loisirs, culture, voyages.)Un cadre clair, des avantages concrets, et un accompagnement réel pour avancer sereinement dans votre carrière.

title: Technicien SAV (H/F)
description: Vous savez remettre en service un fauteuil roulant, un lit médicalisé ou un autre équipement d'aide à domicile sans perdre de temps ?Au sein de VYV Équipement Médical, vous intervenez sur des équipements mécaniques, électriques et électroniques. Vous passez de l'atelier aux livraisons chez les clients, avec des priorités qui changent selon les urgences.Le poste est en CDI à temps plein, à Larressore, avec une prise de poste dès que possible. Vous échangez avec les clients, les commerciaux et les fournisseurs pour suivre chaque demande jusqu'à la remise en service.Vous gérez aussi les devis, les commandes, les bons de livraison, les retours SAV et le stock. Les règles de sécurité, la décontamination et le respect des délais font partie du quotidien.Vos missions s'articulent autour de plusieurs priorités techniques et administratives.- Effectuer l'entretien, le dépannage, la remise en état, la surveillance et l'installation d'équipements à dispositifs mécaniques, électriques, électroniques, automatiques (ex : fauteuils roulants, lits médicalisés...).-  Assurer la réparation, l'adaptation et le suivi technique du matériel livré aux besoins spécifiques des clients (conseils spécialisés et aménagement ou transformation du matériel).- Gérer les démarches administratives relevant de sa responsabilité : relance des devis en attente d'accord, élaboration des devis/commandes/BL clients et fournisseurs....- Gérer le flux des demandes des clients, des commerciaux HMS et élaborer un planning d'intervention en fonction des priorités.- Gérer les retours SAV et prendre contact avec les fournisseurs en cas de litige (commande incomplète, matériel détérioré, erreur sur le matériel livré, retard sur la livraison...) en organisant les relances, le retour du matériel défectueux ou l'éventuel échange sous garantie.- Déterminer des délais d'intervention pour chaque réparation et s'assurer de leur respect.- Gérer le stock des marchandises, matériaux et outils.- Assurer l'entretien technique du parc locatif.- Effectuer la livraison, l'installation, la mise en service des produits à domicile et éventuellement l'enlèvement des marchandises.- Décontaminer le matériel à livrer ou de retour de location.Vous travaillez avec des personnes aux besoins précis et des interlocuteurs multiples. Cela demande de la rigueur, de la réactivité et une bonne tenue administrative.Si vous aimez passer de la mécanique au contact client, ce poste demande de la méthode, de l'autonomie et un vrai sens de l'organisation.- Formation ou expérience en mécanique, électricité ou électrotechnique, avec de solides réflexes terrain.- Vous dépannez, réparez et remettez en état des équipements avec méthode et précision.- Vous savez installer, livrer et mettre en service du matériel chez le client.- Vous tenez devis, commandes et bons de livraison sans perdre le fil.- Vous organisez plusieurs demandes, fixez des délais et respectez les priorités.- Vous êtes à l'aise avec la sécurité, le stock, la traçabilité et les échanges externes.

description: Animateur et coordonnateur d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, le médecin du travail : * assure le suivi de l'état de santé des salariés, * conseille les employeurs et les accompagne dans
