Wir setzen uns für die Rechte der jungen Menschen ein, sowohl auf individueller als auch auf gesellschaftlicher Ebene.Ihre Aufgabenstellung:- Aufbau einer tragfähigen Arbeitsbeziehung zu den jungen Menschen, auf deren Basis gemeinsam, kreativ und individuell die Persönlichkeitsentwicklung unterstützt wird- Betreuung und Begleitung von jungen Menschen in allen zentralen Bereichen der Lebensgestaltung u.a.: behördliche und schulische Angelegenheiten, Asyl- und Aufenthaltsverfahren, Wohnungssuche, Freizeitgestaltung, Elternarbeit- Planung und Gestaltung der individuellen Hilfen sowie gemeinsame Auswertung dieser mit den jungen Menschen und anderen Beteiligten- Durchführung (freizeit-)pädagogischer Einzel- und Gruppenangebote- Kooperation u.a. mit Jugendämtern, Schulen, Ärztinnen, Therapeutinnen, Rechtsanwältinnen, gesetzlichen Vertreterinnen- Qualitäts- und Konzeptionsentwicklung mit Team und LeitungWir bieten Ihnen:- eine unbefristete Teilzeitstelle mit 30 Stunden pro Woche- Vergütung nach AVR-DWBO, EST 9, Fassung West zzgl. Kinderzulage für jedes Kind, für das Sie Kindergeld erhalten, eine jährliche Sonderzahlung sowie eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge- sehr gute Entwicklungs-, Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten- regelmäßige Teambesprechungen und Supervision- 31 Tage Erholungsurlaub + 1 zusätzlicher Urlaubstag & 2 arbeitsfreie Tage- Die Vereinbarkeit von Privatem und Beruf ist uns ein wichtiges Anliegen. Wir berücksichtigen private und familiäre Angelegenheiten bestmöglich bei der Arbeitszeitplanung und –gestaltung.- viele weitere Vorteile, die Siehier unserer Homepage entnehmen könnenVoraussetzungen sind:- Abschluss als staatlich anerkannter Sozialpädagogein, Sozialarbeiter*in (m/w/d) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation- offene und wertschätzende Kommunikationsformen- teamfähiges, engagiertes, selbstständiges, strukturiertes und verbindliches Arbeiten- partizipative und antidiskriminierende Haltung in der Betreuung und darüber hinaus- interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit insbesondere mit dem psychologischen Dienst des PGWWünschenswert sind:- Erfahrung in der professionellen Betreuung vonjungen Menschen- Kenntnisse in der Arbeit mit traumatisierten jungen Menschen sowie psychisch instabilen Menschen und idealerweise eine traumapädagogische Zusatzqualifikation- Sprachkompetenz, gerne auch muttersprachlich, insbesondere außereuropäischer Sprachen für die Betreuung- Erfahrung in der Kooperation mit Jugendämtern und SchulenUnabhängig von Ihrer Konfession identifizieren Sie sich mit dem Diakonischen Auftrag und gestalten diesen gerne mit.****Ihre Ansprechpartnerin für Rückfragen: Vera Koppen, Tel.: 030/644 92 90 - 41Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung unter dem angegebenen Link! title: Senior IT-Infrastructure Analyst (m/w/d) in Koblenz (IT-Konfigurationskoordinator/in)
description: ZF is a global technology company supplying advanced mobility products and systems for passenger cars, commercial vehicles and industrial technology. Its comprehensive product range is primarily aimed at vehicle manufacturers, mobility providers and start-up companies in the fields of transportation and mobility. ZF electrifies a wide range of vehicle types. With its products, the company contributes to reducing emissions, protecting the climate as well as enhancing safe mobility.Alongside the automotive sector - passenger cars and commercial vehicles - ZF also serves market segments such as construction and agricultural machinery, wind power, marine propulsion, rail drives and test systems.With some 168,700 employees worldwide, ZF reported sales of €46.6 billion in fiscal year 2023. The company operates 162 production locations in 31 countries.Wir verstärken unser Team IT Region Germany West am Standort #Koblenz und suchen eine/n IT Infrastructure Analyst - Network (m/w/d).Die regionale #IT stellt einen stabilen, sicheren und zukunftsfähigen IT-Betrieb an unseren Standorten sicher. Unser Fokus liegt auf lokaler IT- und Shopfloor-Infrastruktur, #Netzwerk- und Workplace-Services, OT/IT-Integration, #Cybersecurity sowie der Umsetzung globaler IT-Standards. Als Partner der Produktion und Fachbereiche unterstützen wir Business Continuity, Digitalisierung und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Landschaft.Was Sie erwarten können als IT Infrastructure Analyst - Network (m/w/d):- Support der lokalen #IT-Infrastruktur (#IoT/End-Device / #Backend / Dokumentation) sowie Tätigkeiten im Bereich der aktiven & passiven Netzwerkkomponenten- Mitarbeit in der Implementierung, Konzeption, Weiterentwicklung und fortlaufenden Verbesserung der IT- Standards sowie Unterstützung der internen IT-Organisationen- Steuerung von externen Dienstleistern sowie Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit mit internen Kunden/ Anwendern und anderen Bereichen der IT-Organisation- Koordination und Steuerung von lokalen/globalen Digitalisierungs- und Zukunftsprojekten, sowie die Erstellung entsprechender Reportings und deren Präsentation- Mitarbeit in übergreifenden Support-TeamsWas wir von Ihnen erwarten als IT Infrastructure Analyst - Network (m/w/d):- Abgeschlossenes Studium der #Informatik, #Elektrotechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie erste/mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im IT-Infrastruktur Produktionsumfeld und Projekte- Vorausgesetzt werden Kenntnisse im Bereich #LAN / #WAN / #WLAN (#Cisco, #Juniper, #Aruba),Server/Storage (#NAS / #SAN), Kenntnisse im Bereich Produktions-Systeme und -Prozesse (#MES / #SCADA, #IoT etc.) sind wünschenswert- Sehr gute Fähigkeiten im Umgang mit IT-Anwendern, externen Dienstleistern und internen Abteilungen- Ausgeprägte Hands-On-Mentalität, hohe Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität- Sehr gute Deutsch- und EnglischkenntnisseWarum sollten Sie sich für ZF in Koblenz entscheiden?- 30 Urlaubstage- Metallrente- Home Office Option- Flexible ArbeitszeitenDer Grundentgeltanspruch wird entsprechend der individuellen Vorkenntnisse ermittelt. title: Pâtissier (m/w/d) in Vollzeit bzw. Teilzeit 80 % (Koch/Köchin)
description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:BäckerStellenbeschreibung:Pâtissier (m/w/d) in Vollzeit bzw. Teilzeit 80 %Das Fürstliche Golf- & Natur-Resort Bad Waldsee liegt auf dem Gelände eines ehemaligen fürstlichen Hofgutes – eingebettet in die einzigartige Natur Oberschwabens. Auf rund 360 Hektar verbinden sich Sport, Kulinarik und Erholung zu einem besonderen Erlebnis.Zum Resort gehören neben einer der größten 45-Loch-Golfanlagen Deutschlands ein 4-Sterne-Hotel, mehrere Restaurants und Veranstaltungsbereiche sowie ein umfangreiches Sport-, Fitness- und Wellnessangebot. Über 1.000 Mitglieder und zahlreiche Gäste genießen jedes Jahr die besondere Atmosphäre unseres Resorts.Für unsere Restaurants „Ausblick T-19“ und „Hopfenweiler Stüble“ suchen wir einen Koch mit Schwerpunkt Pâtissier (m/w/d).Ihre Aufgaben- Vor- und Zubereitung von Speisen und Desserts für unsere verschiedenen Gastronomiebereiche.- Eigenständige Herstellung und kreative Gestaltung von Desserts, Torten, Kuchen, Gebäck und süßen Spezialitäten.- Zubereitung und Verarbeitung von Schokolade, Pralinen und weiteren süßen Kreationen.- Herstellung von Eis, Sorbets und saisonalen Dessertvariationen.- Anrichten der Speisen und Übergabe an den Service.- Mitwirkung bei der Planung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Speise- und Dessertkarten.- Überprüfung der Lagervorräte und Verfallsdaten.- Einhaltung aller Lebensmittelhygienevorschriften nach HACCP.Ihr Profil- Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Koch mit Erfahrung im Bereich Pâtisserie oder Konditorei.- Leidenschaft für das Kochen und Freude an der Herstellung hochwertiger Desserts und süßer Kreationen.- Spaß am Umgang mit frischen und regionalen Lebensmitteln.- Kreativität, handwerkliches Geschick und ein gutes Gespür für Geschmack und Optik.- Leistungsbereitschaft, Flexibilität und viel Leidenschaft.- Teamfähigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Engagement.- Eigenverantwortliches, selbstständiges und strukturiertes Arbeiten.Unser AngebotWir bieten Ihnen ein attraktives Arbeitsumfeld in einem außergewöhnlichen Resort mit:- einem erfahrenen und motivierten Küchenteam- einem sicheren Arbeitsplatz mit flachen Hierarchien- attraktiver Vergütung bei transparenter und zeitgenauer Stundenabrechnung- Weihnachts- und Urlaubsgeld- Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge- individuellen Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen WeiterentwicklungZusätzliche Leistungen- Kostenfreie Nutzung unserer zehn Sportangebote (z. B. Golf oder Bogenschießen)- Nutzung von Fitness- und Wellnessbereich- Betriebliches GesundheitsmanagementNähere Auskünfte erteilt Ihnen gerne unser Geschäftsführer, Sascha Binoth, Tel. +49 7524 4017-0.Wir haben Ihr Interesse geweckt?Dann bewerben Sie sich bitte per E-Mail mit Ihren aussagekräftigen Unterlagen, damit wir einen ersten Eindruck von Ihnen und Ihren Fähigkeiten gewinnen können.Bitte senden Sie Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen an: 📧 bewerbung@waldsee-golf.de (https://mailto:bewerbung@waldsee-golf.de)Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

title: Senior Data Center & Colocation Procurement Specialist (m/w/d) (Einkäufer/in)
description: Akkodis is a global Digital Engineering consulting company that brings technology and talent together to accelerate transformation, drive innovation, and shape a smarter future. With more than 50,000 experts across over 30 countries, we connect industries and technologies, ranging from AI and Data Analytics to Cloud, Edge Computing, Automation, and Cybersecurity.DescriptionThe Data Center & Colocation Category is part of the Cloud Infrastructure team under IT & Cloud and supports SAP's global data center expansion and capacity roadmap. This temporary assignment requires a highly experienced procurement specialist with deep, hands-on expertise in the colocation market. The contractor will advise infrastructure, engineering, finance, legal, and business stakeholders on sourcing strategy and translate complex requirements for capacity, power, location, connectivity, resilience, sustainability, scalability, and deployment timing into commercially robust procurement outcomes.The Senior Data Center & Colocation Procurement Specialist will independently lead complex, business-critical sourcing work for colocation services across regions. The assignment covers the full procurement lifecycle-from market intelligence, supplier shortlisting, RFx design, bid normalization, site and capacity evaluation, and commercial modelling through negotiation and execution of master service agreements, statements of work, order forms, and related amendments. The contractor is expected to challenge requirements constructively, identify commercial leverage, and provide crediblerecommendations with minimal ramp-up or supervision.Key deliverables include category and market insights, sourcing strategies, RFx packages, normalized proposal evaluations, should-cost and total-cost-of-ownership models, negotiation plans, contract positions, executive decision materials, risk assessments, and supplier governance outputs. The contractor must be capable of owning assigned workstreams end to end, navigating ambiguity, and securing competitive outcomes while protecting capacity, service continuity, flexibility, and contractual risk. The engagement does not include ongoing people-management responsibility or independent authority to commit SAP.Key ResponsibilitiesWe are seeking a senior procurement practitioner who has built substantial, recent experience sourcing data center colocation capacity and can contribute immediately. This is not a generalist procurement role. The successful contractor will bring detailed knowledge of the global and regional colocation supplier landscape, commercial structures, capacity constraints, negotiation levers, and contracting risks.The ideal candidate has personally led high-value, multi-site or multi-region colocation transactions and is comfortable engaging directly with major operators and regional providers. They can interrogate technical demand, normalize non-standard proposals, model long-term commercial exposure, negotiate complex protections, and turn incomplete inputs into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders. Success requires an independent, delivery-focused specialist with strong commercial judgment rather than a coordinator or developing category professional.What will you do?- Lead complex global sourcing for colocation capacity, power, connectivity, and related datacenter services.- Develop sourcing strategies using market intelligence, supplier capacity, pricing, and regional risk.- Translate technical and business requirements into effective RFI, RFQ, and RFP processes.- Evaluate proposals and build TCO models covering power, fees, indexation, commitments,ramp schedules, and exit costs.- Lead commercial negotiations on price, capacity, flexibility, service levels, remedies, renewals and termination rights.- Support colocation agreements and order documentation with legal, technical, finance, andbusiness stakeholders.- Assess supplier, site, delivery, resilience, sustainability, and regulatory risks.- Present clear recommendations, benchmarks, trade-offs, and risk mitigations to seniorstakeholders.- Drive savings, supplier governance, procurement documentation, and end-of-assignmenthandover.ProfileRequired Qualifications- 10+ years of experience in strategic procurement, category management, or complex sourcing, including at least 5 years in data center colocation procurement.- Proven experience leading large-scale, international colocation sourcing and contract negotiations.- Strong knowledge of colocation commercial models, cost structures, and data center requirements.- Advanced skills in TCO modelling, cost analysis, benchmarking, scenario analysis, and bid evaluation.- Extensive experience negotiating complex colocation contracts, including SLAs, capacity commitments, pricing, renewals, termination, and liability.- Strong understanding of the global and regional colocation provider market, including supplier evaluation and risk assessment.- Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to work independently in complex environments.- Excellent written and spoken English, including executive-level communication and contract negotiations.- Degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Supply Chain, IT, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; procurement certification is a plus.

title: Information Security Officer (Junior)
description: JBT Marel is seeking an Information security officer (Junior).Purpose:The Information Security Officer is part of the Information Security department within JBT Marel. The Information Security department is responsible for both Risk Management and Security Operations. The Information Security Officer supports the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security framework across the business. The role acts as a security liaison between business, technology and security teams and provides practical, risk-aligned guidance within assigned areas of responsibility.It is your mission to help identify, assess and document security risks across information, processes, projects and technologies, and to support the mitigation of those risks. You know how to collaborate with stakeholders, communicate clearly, and balance security requirements with business value and usability. The Information Security Officer closely cooperates with Cyber Security Specialists and other Information Security colleagues in audits, change management, incident coordination, awareness activities, policy updates and continuous improvement initiatives. Reports to:Chief Information Security Officer. Key areas of accountability: Risk management and advisory:Identify, assess and document security risks across information processes, projects and technologies within assigned areas of responsibility.Provide constructive security advisory for inquiries related to areas of responsibility, applying established guidelines and escalating complex topics where needed.Collaborate with business stakeholders to provide clear guidance and support the development of pragmatic, risk-aligned solutions.Support mitigation planning by providing input on security risks, controls and improvement actions.Policy management:Write and update security policies, standards and procedures for assigned areas of responsibility.Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security policies, standards and procedures.Identify gaps in policies, standards and guidelines and propose improvements to reduce security risks. Security awareness:Promote security awareness by delivering training and championing Information Security objectives.Assess current security awareness maturity in assigned areas and use insights to drive targeted improvements and clear communication.Support the adoption of the right security behavior based on JBT Marel’s policies, standards and guidelines. Reporting, audits and operations:Report on security posture and incidents within assigned areas of responsibility.Participate in technical and non-technical audits, change management processes and incident coordination activities.Apply established guidelines to analyze and resolve routine security issues.Identify opportunities for control enhancement and process improvement in assigned areas of responsibility.Support continuous improvement of the organization’s security posture and monitor advancements in Information Security best practices.Team contribution:Operate with moderate supervision and seek guidance where needed.Support onboarding or training of new team members when requested.Provide input to employee performance evaluations as needed.Competencies and Skills:     Relating and networkingPresenting and communicating informationWriting and reportingAnalytical thinkingCooperativePro-activeConceptual/forward thinkingThoroughnessStress managementPragmatic and risk-based mindsetProficient English writing and speakingLevel of Knowledge and Experience:Bachelor level in information management and auditing, IT/information security, computer sciences, or a suitable combination of formal education and experience.1 - 3 years of experience in information security, risk management, IT audit, technology governance or a related field.Basic understanding of risk management, security policy management, security awareness, incident coordination and control improvement.Knowledge of international security standards or frameworks, such as ISO 27001, IEC 62443, OWASP, CIS Controls, NIST or ISF Standard of Good Practice, is desired.Preferred: experience in working in an international/ global organization.Preferred: knowledge of the manufacturing industry and business model/processes.Why Join JBT Marel?Joining JBT Marel means becoming part of a global leader in food processing technology that is helping feed the world more sustainably. You'll collaborate with talented colleagues across multiple countries, work on strategic global initiatives, and have opportunities to develop your career in an innovative, purpose-driven organization committed to continuous improvement, customer success, and operational excellence. Interested?📧 Apply by clicking the link to access the vacancy on JBT Marel´s website: https://jbtm.wd108.myworkdayjobs.com/JBT_Marel_Career_Site/job/IS---Gardabaer/Information-Security-Officer--Junior-_25689.🌐 Learn more about us at: JBTMarel.com🔗 Follow us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/jbtmarel/Last application date is November 17, 2026. Join us - and help shape the future of maintenance excellence at JBT Marel.Use of Technology in Our Hiring ProcessJBT Marel uses technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support the review of applications.These tools help our recruiting teams identify skills and experience relevant to the role based on job-related criteria.All applications are reviewed by people, and AI is not used to make hiring decisions independently. We are committed to fair, consistent and inclusive hiring practices globally.

title: Engineering Manager
description: Fenris Creations is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the infrastructure engineering team behind EVE Online.EVE runs as a single shared universe, where every player has an opportunity to leave a mark on a 20-year running persistent game experience. Our game cluster spans our own datacenter hardware and AWS. Our tight-knit team owns this infrastructure end-to-end: servers and network gear in the racks, the cloud networks and Golang domain specific services in AWS, and the incident, change management, testing, alerting, automation, and budget processes that keep it all running.You'll lead the engineers who build and run that platform. You'll set technical direction, own reliability and cost, and stay close enough to the work to make good calls during an outage or a hardware refresh. This is a hands-on management role.The role is based in Reykjavík, Iceland. We are a hybrid office, and offer flexibility around which days are in-office and which can be worked remotely.Your Tasks:Lead the teamHire, coach, and grow infrastructure engineers. Run 1:1s, give performance feedback, and guide career growth.Set the team's priorities across new platform work, requests from game teams, operational load, and technical debt.Run planning with product owners and other engineering leads.Own reliabilityRun the incident management process: on-call rotations and expectations, escalation paths, alerting, and blameless postmortems.Guide production change management, setting policy on deployment reviews, maintenance windows, and rollback plans, and so on.Define and track SLIs and SLOs for core services and set team priorities in response.Own the platformGuide architecture for our on-premise datacenter and AWS environments, and how traffic moves between them.Oversee hardware lifecycle: procurement, bare-metal provisioning, firmware and OS updates, and decommissioning.Own network design and security across both environments, from Cisco routers and firewalls to VPCs, Transit Gateways, and access controls.Push for automation wherever possible, in provisioning, configuration, CI/CD, and observability, to minimize engineering TOIL.Own the budgetSet the cloud and on-premise infrastructure budgets, and forecast spend as the game grows.Manage vendor relationships and contracts with cloud, datacenter, CDN, and tooling providers.Find and deliver cost savings without trading away reliability.Your Profile:Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.8+ years in infrastructure, systems, site reliability, or distributed systems engineering.2+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance management.Strong grasp of distributed systems — message queues, service discovery, consistency, failure modes, and how to debug them in production.Hands-on experience running physical hardware in a datacenter — bare-metal provisioning, server and storage lifecycle, and working with colocation providers.Deep cloud provider experience, especially in networking and security (VPCs, Transit Gateways, routing, security groups) and running services at scale.Solid networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, routing protocols such as BGP, VLANs, firewalls, and router configuration.Experience leading incident response and building on-call and postmortem practices.Comfort reading and reviewing code in Golang or Python.Experience owning or forecasting an infrastructure budget.Strong technical writing and spoken communication skills in English — design docs, tradeoff analyses — and a track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical projects across multiple project and executive stakeholders.Nice to have:Experience with RabbitMQ, NATS, or other message brokers in production.Experience with DynamoDB and Redis.Automation with Python and Ansible.Bare-metal provisioning with PXE boot, Tinkerbell, or similar tools.Infrastructure as code with Terraform, and CI/CD with TeamCity or GitHub Actions.Observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Honeycomb.Background in game services or other low-latency, high-concurrency systems.Experience with hybrid on-premise and cloud environments, or migrations between them.Our stackOur cloud platform is a set of Golang microservices in AWS, built around a service gateway and RabbitMQ message queues. On-premise, we run our own servers and Cisco network gear in the datacenter, managed with Ansible and Python.Area.Tools.Languages.Golang, Python.Messaging.RabbitMQ, NATS.Data.DynamoDB, Redis.Cloud.AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateways, EKS).Datacenter.Cisco routers, PXE boot, Ansible.Automation and CI/CD.Terraform, TeamCity.What We Can Offer You:The chance to work on EVE Online with talented, ambitious colleagues.A multicultural workplace that encourages growth and new ideas.Dual-monitor workstation and a flexible work environment.An active fun division that hosts regular events.A canteen with weekly breakfast and lunch menus, plus drinks and snacks.Discretionary quarterly and annual. performance sharing plan.Annual sports grant.Mobile phone and mobile plan.Home internet.Conditional monthly transportation grant.Free on-site doctor and other on-site. services at a discount.Relocation package.Please submit your application in English by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/29d70840-8361-4fc9-ac2a-de524d85fba0

title: Principal Specialist - QA Engineering
description: Alvotech hf is seeking a Principal Specialist - QA EngineeringWork location - Sæmundargata 15-19, Reykjavik. The position is 100%. Key responsibilities and minimum requirements according to the role:• Provide QA oversight and collaborate with cross-functional teams in planning maintenance, qualification, and validation activities for facilities, utilities, equipment, and computer systems (CSV).• Serve as a Quality representative and a subject matter expert (SME) in selection, design and build of new technologies and new facilities within Alvotech.• Support and provide QA oversight with review and approval of qualification documents for facility, utility, equipment and computerized systems as applicable.• Contribute to investigations into discrepancies arising during qualification / validation activities and subsequent approval of appropriate corrective actions.• Review of planned and unplanned work orders for maintenance, preventive maintenance, calibrations and other engineering related activities.• Reviews and approve change controls, deviations, CAPAs, effectiveness checks for facilities, utilities, and equipment, computer systems.• Stay current on applicable external requirements and industry standards and drive continuousimprovement on engineering and CSV processes and tools.• Advice on quality matters, and assistance for closing compliance gaps found in audits andAt the end of the day, the Sen• Escalation of any data integrity or critical quality issues to the supervisor and Quality Management of Alvotech• Responsible for ensuring all facilities, utilities, equipment, computer systems are appropriately validated and qualification in line with current EU and US legislation for parenteral/biologics.Minimum education and experience required for the role:• A bachelor's degree within relevant area, or other relevant business experience• Minimum 5 years of experience within the Pharmaceutical or Medical Device Industry (preferably in parenteral/biologics formulations).• Experience working with regulatory requirements in GxP required (Preferably FDA and EU regulations).• Good understanding of GAMP 5 guide required.• Knowledge of and experience with validation and qualification specifically within facility, utility, and equipment/computer systems.What we offer:•     An inspiring challenge to work with great co-workers on ambitious projects that change people's lives.•       The chance to be a part of a global and fast-growing company.•       An international work culture that encourages diversity, collaboration and inclusion.•       Positive, flexible, and innovative work environment.•       Support for personal growth and internal career development.•       Company social events and milestone celebrations.•       Excellent in-house canteen and coffee house.•       Exercise and wellbeing support for full-time employees.•       On-site shower facility.•       Transportation grant towards eco-friendly modes of travel for full-time employees.•       Internet at home for full-time employees.About Us: At Alvotech, we are building a global biotechnology company with a clear purpose: to expand access to high-quality, affordable biologic medicines for patients worldwide. Our people are central to that mission. Across our global teams, we bring together expertise in science, manufacturing, quality and commercial operations to shape the future of biosimilars.We offer a dynamic, fast-moving environment where curiosity, initiative and ownership are encouraged. Rooted in Icelandic values and operating on a global stage, we value collaboration, diversity and integrity across everything we do. Our teams work on meaningful challenges, contribute directly to patient impact, and grow alongside the business.Whether you are at the start of your career or looking to take your next step, Alvotech offers the opportunity to do work that matters, in a company driven by purpose and scale.If you do not see a role that matches your experience today, we still welcome general applications from individuals who share our ambition and want to help improve access to biologic medicines worldwide.Please contact: hr@alvotech.com to apply for the position. title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: HEADCHEF TILL MICHELIN GUIDE-REKOMMENDERAD RESTAURANG I REYKJAVÍK
description: Är du redo att sätta din egen prägel på en av Islands mest spännande gastronomiska destinationer?Nu söker vi en kreativ och ambitiös Head Chef till en välrenommerad fine dining-restaurang i Reykjavík. Restaurangen är utvald av MICHELIN Guide (2026) och erbjuder samtida isländsk gastronomi med tydliga rötter i landets matkultur.Det här är en sällsynt möjlighet för dig som vill leda ett engagerat köksteam, utveckla en egen kulinarisk riktning och arbeta nära några av Nordens mest särpräglade råvaror.OM RESTAURANGENRestaurangen arbetar med modern isländsk matlagning där säsong, hållbarhet och lokala råvaror står i centrum. Menyerna följer årstiderna och bygger på det bästa som Island har att erbjuda – från fisk, skaldjur och lamm till vilda örter, tång och råvaror från lokala producenter.Verksamheten har nyligen flyttat till nya lokaler med ett större och uppgraderat kök. Den nya kökschefen får därför stor kreativ frihet att utveckla menyerna och vara med och forma restaurangens framtida gastronomiska inriktning.ROLLENSom Head Chef får du det övergripande kulinariska och operativa ansvaret för köket. Du leder teamet i den dagliga driften och säkerställer att varje servering håller en jämn och mycket hög nivå.Rollen omfattar bland annat:    Ledning, utveckling och motivation av köksteamet    Utveckling av säsongsbaserade menyer    Kvalitetssäkring och konsekvent nivå i varje servering    Planering, struktur och ett effektivt arbetsflöde i köket    Nära arbete med lokala och hållbara råvaror    Att vidareutveckla restaurangens identitet och gastronomiska riktning    Att skapa en professionell, trygg och inkluderande kökskulturVEM SÖKER VI?Vi söker dig som är kreativ, ambitiös och trygg i ett professionellt kök. Du har en stark bakgrund inom fine dining och förstår de krav på precision, kvalitet och helhetsupplevelse som ställs på MICHELIN Guide-nivå.Du kan redan arbeta som Head Chef, men vi välkomnar även en mycket skicklig Sous Chef som är redo att ta nästa steg in i en ledande roll.Vi tror att du har:    Gedigen erfarenhet från fine dining eller annan gastronomisk verksamhet på hög nivå    Erfarenhet av menyutveckling och arbete med säsongsbaserade råvaror    Ett tydligt och närvarande ledarskap    Förmåga att skapa struktur, kvalitet och arbetsglädje i köket    Ett genuint intresse för hållbarhet och lokala råvaror    Förmåga att kombinera kreativitet med kvalitet, ekonomi och stabil drift    God kommunikativ förmåga i en internationell arbetsmiljöErfarenhet från en Michelin-restaurang eller motsvarande gastronomisk nivå är meriterande, men rätt potential, ledarskap och ambition kan vara lika viktigt.ETT KÖK MED EN STARK KVINNLIG TRADITIONUnder de senaste tio åren har restaurangens kök bestått av ett kvinnligt team. Verksamheten har ett starkt engagemang för att stödja kvinnor inom gastronomin och skapa möjligheter för kvinnliga kockar att utvecklas till ledare.Vi vill fortsätta bygga en arbetsplats där kvinnor kan växa, påverka och ta plats i gastronomiska ledarroller. Samtidigt välkomnar vi kvalificerade sökande oavsett kön och gör urvalet utifrån kompetens, ledarskap, motivation och potential.DET HÄR ERBJUDS    En central ledarroll på en MICHELIN Guide-rekommenderad restaurang    Stor kreativ frihet att påverka menyer och gastronomisk inriktning    Ett större och nyligen uppgraderat restaurangkök    Tillgång till unika isländska råvaror och lokala producenter    Möjlighet att leda och utveckla ett ambitiöst köksteam    En internationell karriärmöjlighet i Reykjavík    Boendemöjligheter finns och diskuteras individuellt    Lön, startdatum och övriga villkor enligt överenskommelseOM REYKJAVÍKReykjavík erbjuder en ovanlig kombination av kreativ storstad, levande restaurangkultur och storslagen natur. Här finns havet, bergen, varma källor och några av Nordens mest intressanta råvaror alldeles i närheten.För rätt person är detta mer än ett nytt arbete. Det är möjligheten att skapa något eget och samtidigt uppleva ett nytt land, en ny matkultur och en ny vardag.ANSÖKANRekryteringen genomförs av Wildcard Untap, som hjälper verksamheter inom hotell och restaurang att hitta kvalificerade specialister och ledare genom aktiv search, personlig dialog och professionellt omdöme.Skicka CV och en kort presentation av din erfarenhet, ditt ledarskap och din gastronomiska filosofi till:jobb@wildcarduntap.comMärk ansökan: ”Head Chef – Reykjavík”Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt.

title: Information Security Officer (Junior)
description: JBT Marel is seeking an Information security officer (Junior).Purpose:The Information Security Officer is part of the Information Security department within JBT Marel. The Information Security department is responsible for both Risk Management and Security Operations. The Information Security Officer supports the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security framework across the business. The role acts as a security liaison between business, technology and security teams and provides practical, risk-aligned guidance within assigned areas of responsibility.It is your mission to help identify, assess and document security risks across information, processes, projects and technologies, and to support the mitigation of those risks. You know how to collaborate with stakeholders, communicate clearly, and balance security requirements with business value and usability. The Information Security Officer closely cooperates with Cyber Security Specialists and other Information Security colleagues in audits, change management, incident coordination, awareness activities, policy updates and continuous improvement initiatives. Reports to:Chief Information Security Officer. Key areas of accountability: Risk management and advisory:Identify, assess and document security risks across information processes, projects and technologies within assigned areas of responsibility.Provide constructive security advisory for inquiries related to areas of responsibility, applying established guidelines and escalating complex topics where needed.Collaborate with business stakeholders to provide clear guidance and support the development of pragmatic, risk-aligned solutions.Support mitigation planning by providing input on security risks, controls and improvement actions.Policy management:Write and update security policies, standards and procedures for assigned areas of responsibility.Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security policies, standards and procedures.Identify gaps in policies, standards and guidelines and propose improvements to reduce security risks. modes, and how to debug them in production.Hands-on experience running physical hardware in a datacenter — bare-metal provisioning, server and storage lifecycle, and working with colocation description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. title: Supervisor – Community Employment (CE)
description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. These guidelines are included in the job specification for the CE Supervisor.  Job Title: Supervisor - Community Employment  Reporting to: Project Manager and Chairperson - RDRD Project Management Committee Function: To ensure the effective and efficient management and co-ordination of the human, financial and material resources of the CE Scheme and report to the Project Management Committee on its implementation. A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. ICT skills essential (e.g. MS Office) and certification in Addiction Studies ideal. Salary & Benefits • Salary: Aligned with DSP CE Supervisor Scale, commencing at Point 1. Although in the case of a person already employed as a CE supervisor being the successful candidate, they would receive their current rate of pay. • 39 hours per week standard full-time role. • Access to staff support, CISM (Critical Incident Stress Management), and Employee Assistance services. Apply by sending CV to the manager at catherine.meleady@rdrd.ie or by post to the Manager, 17 Irishtown Road, Dublin D04PW10.  Closing date for applications is 5pm on Tuesday 17th of November.

title: Senior Loans Officer
description: Senior Loans OfficerThe Credit Union has grown strongly over the past number of years, both in the level of activity and in the complexity of its business. We are seeking to recruit an experienced, multi-skilled, hands-on Head of Credit with a proactive nature to join our Management Team and assist in the further development of our business.The Role:Reporting to the CEO, the Head of Credit is a key member of the Management Team and plays a crucial role in the operation and development of the lending function within the Credit Union. The Head of Credit has direct responsibility for the overall management of the lending department, loan book growth, meeting lending targets and fostering a culture of exceptional service to members while promoting responsible lending practices.The Head of Credit will safeguard the strong asset quality in the Credit Union’s existing and future loan book. This will involve the continual development and implementation of loan assessment procedures and practices to support credit underwriting decisions. The Head of Credit will assess and approve loans within limits set by the Credit Union and ensure that the lending function operates within the risk tolerance and appetite as set out in the Credit Union’s credit and risk management policies. The role will also involve managing key operational processes and procedures, drafting processes and procedures and improving the overall operational effectiveness of the department.Key responsibilities:•    Provide strong and proactive management of the lending department.•    Ensure the lending department delivers a high-quality service in an effective and efficient manner.•    Build and maintain a strong lending team through effective recruiting, training, coaching, mentoring and team building.•    Design, implement and monitor activities within the lending department.•    Manage the overall loan portfolio, including personal loans, business loans and other lending products.•    Monitor the portfolio's performance, credit quality, and risk exposure, and take appropriate actions to ensure its stability and value.•    Assess and underwrite loan applications including analysis of financial accounts and business plans where appropriate.•    Interview members in relation to their loan applications and borrowing capacity.•    Assist with the restructuring and refinancing of stressed loans, including negotiations with financial and legal advisers.•    Review and recommend changes to credit policies and procedures.•    Operate within agreed lending policies, limits, and other criteria.•    Ensure compliance with relevant financial services legislation and regulation.•    Identify, evaluate and recommend new lending opportunities in a manner that is consistent with the Credit Unions’ strategic and risk management objectives.•    Provide an effective and efficient approach to the business, looking for opportunities to deliver improvements and process enhancements.•    Act as a sounding board for team members and be available to answer more complex queries from staff members.•    Ensure that service delivery expectations are achieved, and commitments are delivered.•    Provide support and regular reports to the CEO, other members of the Management Team, the Credit Committee, and the Board of Directors on lending activities.The successful candidate would preferably have the following:       •    A minimum of five years relevant lending and underwriting experience in personal loans, mortgages, lending to self-employed individuals and small and medium sized enterprises.•    A degree in Finance, Business, or a related discipline.•    A minimum of a QFA qualification.•    Ability to assess, critically evaluate and interpret complex information and to identify key credit risk drivers.•    Excellent people management skills with the ability to lead, motivate and train team members.•    Excellence in verbal and written communication, reporting and interpersonal skills.•    Proficiency in ICT skills across various applications.•    Excellent organisational skills with demonstrable ability to develop and enhance work practices.•    Ability to work on own initiative and as part of a team to deliver agreed targets.•    An appreciation and an awareness of the credit union ethos. Canvassing will disqualify Applications for the above position detailing education and experience should be made to killianconsulting@gmail.comThe Credit Union’s Data Privacy Statement can be accessed via the website

title: Residential Care Worker
description: Are you passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of children? Do you thrive in a dynamic and supportive work environment? We have the perfect opportunity for you! Join our team at Ashdale Care (Ireland), on our journey to transform the lives of young people with complex, emotional and behavioural needs.No two days are the same here in Ashdale Care, this job description is designed to be flexible and adaptable, providing guiding principles for the work rather than strict limitations. It will undergo periodic review to ensure alignment with evolving organisational needs.  You will be part of a unique team who will work together to facilitate excellent practice and be part of rebuilding children’s lives. Our vision is for every young person who lives with us to experience a safe, happy and nurturing present and a future that is filled with hope and optimism.    Cultivate genuine and caring connections with the young people, always interact with the young people and their families with dignity and respect, promoting a culture of unconditional positive regard.    Contribute to the promotion, creation, and maintenance of a welcoming, safe, caring, stable and therapeutic environment.    Advocate for the rights and responsibilities of each young person while promoting physical, emotional, social, cultural, ethnic, and spiritual wellbeing.    Ensure that young people are not subjected to any forms of abuse and report any concerns according to policy and procedures.    Supervise outings from the home and undertake daily household activities such as cooking and cleaning, as part of positive modelling.    Actively participate in working within the Model of Therapeutic Care.    Be physically able to support with challenging behaviours when needed.    Provide emotional support during difficult or stressful times and encourage young people's participation in care planning, placement planning, decision-making and service delivery.    Integrate understanding of youth trauma and past experiences into practice through specialised training such as Developmental Trauma and Attachment from the Therapeutic Support Team.    Collaborate with support networks, including social workers and educators, guardians and family members.    Collaborate effectively within a team, engaging in regular communication through daily handovers, team meetings, and various reviews and planning sessions. Give and receive feedback on performance with colleagues and managers.    Maintain consistency in execution of childcare plans.    Complete and maintain accurate records and reports for each young person in line with statutory requirements and Ashdale Care policies and procedures.    Take on key worker duties including the handling of daily petty cash, accurately documenting receipts, securely storing money and valuable items and serving as a primary point of contact for professionals/family/young person.

title: Residential Care Worker
description: Are you passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of children? Do you thrive in a dynamic and supportive work environment? We have the perfect opportunity for you! Join our team at Ashdale Care (Ireland), on our journey to transform the lives of young people with complex, emotional and behavioural needs.No two days are the same here in Ashdale Care, this job description is designed to be flexible and adaptable, providing guiding principles for the work rather than strict limitations. It will undergo periodic review to ensure alignment with evolving organisational needs.  You will be part of a unique team who will work together to facilitate excellent practice and be part of rebuilding children’s lives. Our vision is for every young person who lives with us to experience a safe, happy and nurturing present and a future that is filled with hope and optimism.    Cultivate genuine and caring connections with the young people, always interact with the young people and their families with dignity and respect, promoting a culture of unconditional positive regard.    Contribute to the promotion, creation, and maintenance of a welcoming, safe, caring, stable and therapeutic environment.    Advocate for the rights and responsibilities of each young person while promoting physical, emotional, social, cultural, ethnic, and spiritual wellbeing.    Ensure that young people are not subjected to any forms of abuse and report any concerns according to policy and procedures.    Supervise outings from the home and undertake daily household activities such as cooking and cleaning, as part of positive modelling.    Actively participate in working within the Model of Therapeutic Care.    Be physically able to support with challenging behaviours when needed.    Provide emotional support during difficult or stressful times and encourage young people's participation in care planning, placement planning, decision-making and service delivery.    Integrate understanding of youth trauma and past experiences into practice through specialised training such as Developmental Trauma and Attachment from the Therapeutic Support Team.    Collaborate with support networks, including social workers and educators, guardians and family members.    Collaborate effectively within a team, engaging in regular communication through daily handovers, team meetings, and various reviews and planning sessions. Give and receive feedback on performance with colleagues and managers.    Maintain consistency in execution of childcare plans.    Complete and maintain accurate records and reports for each young person in line with statutory requirements and Ashdale Care policies and procedures.    Take on key worker duties including the handling of daily petty cash, accurately documenting receipts, securely storing money and valuable items and serving as a primary point of contact for professionals/family/young person.

title: tecnico chimico
description: GI GROUP SPA, prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, per un'importante realtà industriale internazionale operante nel settore della produzione di apparecchiature ad alta tecnologia, ricerca un: Analista Chimico Responsabilità: Sviluppo metodi e validazione: sviluppare procedure analitiche per metalli (composizione bulk e tracce) con OES/XRF, combustione ed estrazione a caldo; e per metalli in soluzione dopo digestione con ICP-OES/ICP-MS. Pianificare ed eseguire validazione/verifica (accuratezza, ripetibilità/riproducibilità, linearità, range, selettività, robustezza, carryover, LOD/LOQ) e confermare la tracciabilità metrologica tramite CRM. Definire e mantenere i budget di incertezza di misura (preparazione campione, calibrazione, performance strumentale) in linea con applicazione e decision rule. Redigere e mantenere piani/report di validazione e documenti controllati (SOP/WI) con gestione revisioni e valutazione impatti delle modifiche; Data integrity e gestione dati: garantire acquisizione, elaborazione e reporting secondo procedure controllate (configurazione strumenti, audit trail, versioning, calcoli tracciabili). Eseguire review tecnica e validazione risultati (stato calibrazioni, conformità QC, integrità campioni, controlli di plausibilità). Gestire archiviazione sicura e recupero dei dati grezzi/record con leggibilità nel lungo periodo e accessi controllati. Gestire i dati in modo strutturato con LIMS e fogli validati applicando principi ALCOA++. Condurre indagini e azioni correttive per non conformità, eventi di data integrity o QC fuori specifica; implementare CAPA e verificarne l'efficacia; Esecuzione analisi chimiche avanzate: svolgere analisi con metodi validati, inclusa preparazione campioni (pesata, digestione, diluizione), calibrazione e verifiche QC. Preparare reagenti e standard con tracciabilità documentata; gestire CRM e soluzioni di riferimento (stoccaggio, etichettatura, scadenze). Eseguire controlli di routine e verifiche prestazionali; coordinare manutenzione e troubleshooting con fornitori. Assicurare gestione sicura di chimici e rifiuti (risk assessment, DPI, compliance ambientale e regole di sito); Reportistica e interpretazione risultati: preparare report di prova conformi (identificazione metodo, tracciabilità, stato QC, incertezza quando applicabile). Interpretare risultati per caratterizzazione materiali, monitoraggio corrosione, failure analysis e supporto al processo; comunicare conclusioni agli stakeholder. Supportare definizione di decision rules e dichiarazioni di conformità coerenti con requisiti cliente/norme; Gestione subfornitori e audit: valutare tecnicamente report di laboratori esterni (equivalenza metodo, incertezza, evidenze di tracciabilità, adeguatezza QC). Supportare qualifica e follow-up fornitori come esperto di analisi chimiche; contribuire a preparazione ed esecuzione audit. Supportare audit interni/esterni (enti di accreditamento, clienti) fornendo evidenze oggettive su validazione, incertezza, competenza e data management; Requisiti: Laurea in Chimica, Chimica Analitica, Ingegneria Chimica o diploma 5 anni indirizzo chimico; Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nel ruolo all'interno di laboratori industriali accreditati ISO/IEC 17025; Esperienza diretta in attività di analisi composizione metallica e analisi metalli in matrice acquosa ICP-OES/ICP-MS; Conoscenza livello B2/C1 lingua inglese; Cosa offriamo: Inserimento diretto in azienda; CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria; Retribuzione prevista compresa tra €37.000,00 to €48.500,00 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alla mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. Sono inoltre previsti sistemi di incentivazione e premi di risultato; Piano Welfare; Mensa aziendale. description: Per conto di una realtà strutturata operante nel settore chimico-farmaceutico, inserita in una fase di trasformazione digitale e di rafforzamento dei presidi di governance, sicurezza e standardizzazione a livello di Gruppo, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Chief Technology Officer La posizione si colloca a diretto riporto del CIO e rappresenta un ruolo 'ponte' tra l'operatività quotidiana e la definizione/adozione di policy, processi e controlli, con focus particolare sulla gestione delle sussidiarie estere e sul governo dei fornitori. Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Contribuire alla roadmap tecnologica insieme al CIO: priorità di investimento, architetture target, standard, piani di miglioramento e misurazione dell'avanzamento. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description: .....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort- Terminplanung Tour- Ausschankbetrieb- Führerschein Klasse CEPersönliche Voraussetzungen:- Unabhängigkeit- Altersvorgabe 30-58- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusstInteresse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Fahrzeugführung, Gästebetreuung, Technisches Verständnis

title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Grafton Office* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per importante azienda cliente ricerchiamo: Buying Planner La risorsa, inserita all'interno dell'Ufficio Buying e in collaborazione con i Buyer e la Direzione Commerciale, supporterà le attività di pianificazione, monitoraggio e gestione operativa degli ordini, contribuendo all'ottimizzazione della disponibilità del prodotto, della rotazione delle scorte e della marginalità. Nello specifico, la figura inserita si occuperà di: Monitorare le performance di vendita dei prodotti, analizzando sell-in, sell-out, stock, rotazioni, stock coverage e marginalità per categoria, brand, linea e punto vendita, individuando trend, criticità e opportunità commerciali; Supportare la pianificazione degli assortimenti e dei fabbisogni di prodotto per insegna, categoria, stagione e canale distributivo, sulla base dei dati storici, previsionali e degli obiettivi commerciali; Supportare il team Buying nella definizione dei quantitativi di acquisto e nella costruzione dell'assortimento; Monitorare il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ingresso in assortimento fino alla fase di fine stagione, individuando eventuali criticità e opportunità di intervento; Analizzare le giacenze e individuare tempestivamente situazioni di overstock, understock e slow moving, supportando la definizione delle relative azioni correttive; Supportare il team Buying, in collaborazione con Planning & Allocation, nell'individuazione delle esigenze di riassortimento e redistribuzione del prodotto; Monitorare l'andamento dei budget di acquisto e degli obiettivi economici assegnati alle diverse categorie merceologiche, segnalando eventuali scostamenti; Gestire operativamente l'inserimento, l'emissione e l'aggiornamento degli ordini di acquisto a sistema, assicurando la correttezza delle informazioni relative a prodotti, quantità, prezzi e condizioni concordate; Monitorare l'avanzamento degli ordini, verificando conferme d'ordine, variazioni, cancellazioni ed eventuali anomalie e interfacciandosi con i fornitori per gli aspetti operativi; Presidiare il follow-up delle consegne e il rispetto delle tempistiche previste, segnalando tempestivamente eventuali ritardi o scostamenti rispetto alla pianificazione e garantendo l'allineamento tra piano di acquisto, ordini emessi e merce in consegna; Predisporre e mantenere aggiornata la reportistica relativa a ordini, budget impegnato, consegne, stock e performance di prodotto, fornendo analisi a supporto dell'Ufficio Buying e della Direzione Commerciale. Requisiti richiesti: Laurea in discipline economiche, statistiche, gestionali, moda o affini. Esperienza pregressa di almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli di Buying Planning, Merchandise Planning, Buying, Merchandising o Product Management, preferibilmente nel settore fashion retail. Conoscenza delle logiche di assortimento, pianificazione e gestione dello stock nel settore retail. Spiccata capacità di analisi e interpretazione dei dati. Utilizzo avanzato di Excel; gradita la conoscenza di strumenti di Business Intelligence. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il profilo: approccio analitico e commerciale, capacità di lettura delle performance di prodotto, ottime capacità organizzative e di pianificazione, precisione, problem solving, Sede di lavoro: Palermo, Orari: Lun-Ven 8:30 - 13:00 / 14:30 - 18:00 CCNL Commercio Range Retributivo previsto: € 23.300 - € 27.000. title: Tecnico_a di messa in servizio
description:
Hai sempre desiderato lavorare in un settore dinamico e orientato al futuro, contribuendo così alla produzione di energia sostenibile e rinnovabile? Questa è la tua occasione per contribuire a plasmare un futuro verde insieme a Thöni Sustainable Solutions! Italia

Type of Employment:

Full time

Your tasks

* Esecuzione autonoma della messa in servizio di impianti di biogas e dei relativi componenti

* Controlli funzionali e di sicurezza di tutti i sistemi in conformità alle norme tecniche

* Regolazione e ottimizzazione dei parametri dell'impianto per un funzionamento conforme al contratto

* Assistenza durante il collaudo tecnico

* Formazione e istruzione del personale operativo in loco

* Documentazione dei lavori eseguiti e verbali di consegna

* Stretta collaborazione con i responsabili di progetto, i tecnici e il team di assistenza

Your profile

* Formazione tecnica completata (ad es. meccatronico, elettrotecnico) o qualifica equivalente

* Esperienza nel settore degli impianti a biogas, degli impianti energetici o delle messe in servizio industriali - almeno 3 anni

* Conoscenze di tecnologia di controllo, regolazione e misurazione

* Disponibilità a viaggiare regolarmente all'estero

* Stile di lavoro autonomo, strutturato e orientato alle soluzioni

* Capacità di lavorare in team, impegno e orientamento al cliente

* Italiano come lingua madre o fluente, buona padronanza del tedesco o dell'inglese

Our offer

In qualità di datore di lavoro attraente, offriamo a persone di talento e motivate incarichi stimolanti e variegati in un contesto internazionale, con opportunità di crescita a lungo termine. In quanto azienda familiare di successo, attribuiamo grande importanza a un clima di rispetto reciproco e a una collaborazione orientata al lavoro di squadra. Inoltre, ci impegniamo attivamente a favore della sostenibilità e della tutela dell'ambiente, implementando processi che preservano le risorse e lavorando costantemente alla riduzione della nostra impronta ecologica.

Troubleshooting e analisi di anomalie con approccio strutturato (raccolta evidenze, riproducibilità, proposta di fix). Produzione/aggiornamento della documentazione tecnica (specifiche di base, note di rilascio, report test). Programmazione: C++ e/o C# e/o Python; graditi OOP, UML, Design Patterns, DBMS. Familiarità con contesti di automazione industriale e integrazione software-hardware; gradita conoscenza di protocolli/fieldbus e ambienti Linux. description: Grafton Engineering is a team dedicated to enhancing the experience, skills and potential of candidates in Design, Logistics & Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Quality - Safety & Environment, Process & Project Management. Saipem Spa is a global leader in engineering and construction for the energy and infrastructure sectors, delivering complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide. Driven by technological innovation as 'One Company', our 30,000 people from over 130 nationalities in more than 50 countries work every day to enable the energy transition toward Net Zero. At Saipem, we embrace diversity as a driver of innovation and inclusion, while prioritizing people's safety and environmental sustainability, even in the most challenging conditions. As Maintenance Engineering Specialist you will respond to the Maintenance Engineering Lead and be part of the Energy Carriers Business Line within EPC Maintenance and Inspection Engineering Department. Job includes plant reliability analysis, equipment criticality assessment and maintenance plan development. Scope of the work involves activities ranging from acknowledging of process-related conditions and evaluating the equipment detail design. Maintenance Engineering Specialist (MES) is to make sure that the project detailed design is safe and sound from an operation and maintenance point of view, complies with the international standards and meet the requirements arising from contract and technical specification therein referred to. In performing his job, the MES is liaising with client representatives, partners, suppliers and project team. MES regularly reports to the Commissioning, Operation and Maintenance manager the status of the Maintenance Engineering assessment, highlighting areas of concern. How can you support us? supporting the maintenance engineering lead in reviewing the project technical documentation in respect to the contractual requirements, gathering of maintenance related design data from technical disciplines and vendors to build-up a comprehensive plant asset register which includes all the maintainable equipment, preparation of Maintainable Equipment List (MEL) hierarchically organized by functional location which in turn refer to physical asset; operability and maintainability review, support mechanical handling assessment, equipment criticality analysis (ECA) to rank item listed in MEL in view of safety, environment and production requirement, maintenance strategies, procedures, and tasks according to either the original equipment manufacturer data or the results of the performed Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) analysis; operational performance standard preparation; CMMS loading templates preparation Education: Master's Degree/bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or similar qualification Experience: 5+ years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry Languages: English level B2/C1 What else should you know?
